title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter | Remote | Performance Pay for Hunters



We are hiring appointment setters who love the chase.



Our clients are financially successful women ready to transform their love lives. Your job is to reach them fast, qualify them carefully, and book them with our enrollment closers.



What you’ll do:



• Reply to new leads within 5 minutes.



• Work our database of approximately 120,000 contacts to reconnect with women who showed

interest.



• Qualify every prospect against our criteria and book her on a closer’s calendar.



• Confirm every appointment so she shows up.



• Book at least 5 qualified calls a day (25 a week).

You must have.



• Experience as an appointment setter, SDR or inside sales rep, ideally in high-ticket coaching or

services.



• Speed, grit and comfort making many calls and texts every day.



• Warm, polished communication. Our clients are accomplished women who expect excellence.



• Disciplined CRM habits and a love of daily coaching.



How you’ll be paid:



• We pay for results, not seat time. $30 for every qualified call that shows, plus $100 for every client

you set who enrolls.



• Weekly performance pay: $500 a week when you book 25+ qualified calls with a 60%+ show rate,

and $750 a week at 35 or more.



• Training pay: $500 a week for your first 2 weeks while you learn our process.



• At 25 bookings a week, setters typically earn about $6,600 a month, and more as volume grows.



• Growth path: top setters can move into closing.





To apply:



Send your résumé and your recent numbers (daily dials, bookings and show rate). Shortlisted candidates complete a live call role-play.

title: Healthcare Operations & Rostering VA| NDIS / Disability Services
description:
We are an Australian disability support company looking for an exceptional Operations & Rostering Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.

This is not a general VA position.

We are looking for someone who is extremely organised, highly accurate, comfortable working with schedules and records, and capable of noticing when something doesn't look right before it becomes a problem.

If you have previously worked in healthcare, home care, aged care, disability services, medical administration, workforce scheduling or another compliance-heavy environment, we would particularly like to hear from you.

What you'll be responsible for

Your role will include:

- Managing and updating staff rosters

- Coordinating shift changes, cancellations and replacements

- Checking that shifts are correctly allocated

- Communicating roster changes with the relevant team members

- Maintaining accurate participant and staff records

- Monitoring staff compliance documents and expiry dates

- Following up missing documentation

- Maintaining registers, trackers and administrative records

- Reviewing information for errors or inconsistencies

- Supporting onboarding of new staff

- Assisting with i
, complaint and compliance administration

- Preparing reports and maintaining spreadsheets

- Managing
s and administrative follow-ups

- Following established procedures and checklists

- Identifying outstanding actions and following them through to completion

- Escalating issues when something requires management attention

- Improving administrative processes where you identify a better way of doing something

You will be trusted with important operational information, so accuracy and follow-through are non-negotiable.

The person we're looking for

The strongest candidates will have previous experience in one or more of the following:

- Healthcare administration

- Home-care operations

- Disability or aged-care administration

- Medical administration

- Rostering or workforce scheduling

- Compliance administration

- Quality assurance

- Document control

- HR administration

- Operations coordination

Australian NDIS experience is an advantage, but it is not essential if you have strong healthcare or care-sector operations experience.

You will probably excel in this role if:

You notice the small details other people miss.

You don't need someone constantly reminding you to follow something up.

When you find a problem, you investigate it rather than simply passing it on.

You are comfortable working across multiple systems and keeping information accurate between them.

You can follow a process precisely but also recognise when something doesn't make sense.

You understand that a task isn't finished simply because you've sent an
 — it is finished when the required outcome has actually occurred.

You communicate clearly and professionally.

You are comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your area.

This role will NOT suit you if:

You are looking for a basic data-entry position.

You regularly need to be reminded about outstanding work.

You skim instructions rather than reading them carefully.

You are uncomfortable with detailed records, spreadsheets or compliance requirements.

You wait for instructions whenever something unexpected happens.

We would much rather hire one exceptional operator than quickly fill the position with the wrong person.

Systems & skills

You should be confident using:

- Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365

- Excel or Google Sheets

-
 and calendar systems

- Cloud-based record-management systems

- Online rostering or scheduling systems

Experience with CRM, healthcare, HR, rostering or case-management systems is highly regarded.

You do not need to know every system we use. We care more about your ability to learn systems quickly and use them accurately.

How to apply

Please do not send us a generic cover letter.

Start your application with the words:

DETAILS MATTER

Then answer these five questions:

1. Tell us about the most relevant healthcare, home-care, disability, aged-care or medical administration role you have held.

2. What experience do you have managing rosters, schedules, appointments or staff allocation?

3. Give us one real example of a mistake or problem you noticed before anyone else did. What did you notice, and what did you do?

4. Tell us about a role where you were responsible for compliance records, documentation, quality assurance or maintaining accurate information.

5. Imagine a support worker is scheduled to work tomorrow, but while reviewing their file you notice an important compliance document has expired. What would you do?

Please also attach your CV and tell us:

- your expected monthly salary in PHP

- when you could commence

- whether you are currently employed

- your internet connection and backup arrangements

- your preferred working hours

Applications that do not answer the questions above will not progress.

title: SEO MANAGER (ORGANIC SEO ONLY – LONG-TERM ROLE)
description:

We are an Australian facilities management company with a growing digital footprint across multiple service industries. We are looking for a highly capable Organic SEO Manager to take full ownership of our SEO strategy and execution. This is not a junior role, not a “content poster” role, and not a shortcut or black-hat SEO role.



If you rely on AI alone, spam backlinks, or vague SEO theory, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You will own organic SEO end-to-end, including strategy, execution, tracking, and results.



• Full SEO audits and ongoing optimisation of existing websites

• Keyword research focused on commercial intent and local/service SEO

• Content optimisation of existing blogs and service pages (we already have large content libraries)

• Creating SEO briefs and optimisation instructions (not just writing content)

• Technical SEO basics: site structure, indexing, crawl issues, Core Web Vitals awareness

• Backlink strategy focused on quality, relevance, and safety (no PBNs, no spam)

• Monitoring performance via Google Search Console and Analytics

• Clear monthly reporting showing what moved, why it moved, and what’s next



You are expected to think, not just execute tasks.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

• Not social media

• Not paid ads

• Not AI-generated bulk content without human SEO logic

• Not micromanaged



We care about rankings, traffic quality, and conversions, not vanity metrics.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

Only apply if you meet ALL of the following:



• 3+ years hands-on organic SEO experience

• Proven ranking results for competitive or service-based keywords

• Strong keyword research skills (you must understand search intent, not just volume)

• On-page SEO expertise (titles, headings, internal linking, content optimisation)

• Comfortable using Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Experience with WordPress or similar CMS

• Ability to explain SEO decisions clearly in English



If you cannot explain why something works, you are not ready for this role.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED BUT HIGHLY VALUED)

• Basic technical SEO understanding (indexing, crawl paths, site health)

WORK SETUP & EXPECTATIONS

• Direct communication with the company owner

• Clear expectations, no micromanagement



SALARY

Competitive and based on proven ability, not promises. Performance reviews based on measurable SEO outcomes.



HOW TO APPLY (THIS IS IMPORTANT)

To be considered, your application MUST include the following:



A short explanation (in your own words) of how you approach SEO for a service-based business



One example of a website you helped rank, including what you did and what improved

Applications that do not follow these instructions will be ignored.



We are looking for someone who wants stability, ownership, and long-term growth, not someone looking for a short-term gig.



If you’re confident in your SEO skills and want to be judged on results, we want to hear from you.

title: High-Ticket Enrollment Closer
description:
We are hiring 10 proven high-ticket closers.



We are a science-based relationship transformation company. Our clients are financially successful

women (founders, executives, physicians, attorneys) who have built everything except the partnership they want. Our methodology helps them identify and clear the patterns standing in

the way. Our enrollment conversations are deep, discreet and high-trust. They are also high-ticket.



This role is for a hunter. 



You don’t wait for a full calendar. Our setters and AI assistant book qualified calls for you, and you also work a database of approximately 120,000 contacts to find the opportunities everyone else missed. You book them, close them and collect.



Top performers get top leads. Lead access is earned by results. Our most qualified inbound

opportunities go to our highest-level closers.



You must have:



• Completed a recognized high-ticket sales training program, such as SheSells or an equivalent. You’ll tell us which one and show us how you use it.



• A proven record closing high-ticket offers of $5,000 or more on consultative calls. Bring your

numbers: calls taken, close rate and cash collected.



• Self-starter drive. You prospect, book and close in the same role.



• The integrity to qualify hard. We would rather lose a sale than enroll the wrong client.



• Disciplined CRM habits and an appetite for coaching: daily role-play, recorded calls and weekly call

review.



• Speed. New leads hear from you within minutes, not hours.



• Strongly preferred: experience selling to women, or in coaching, wellness or personal development.



How you’ll be paid:



• Months 1–3 (ramp): 10% commission on cash collected, plus any wages required by law.



• Weekly bonuses from week one: hit $50,000, $75,000, $100,000 or $150,000 in upfront cash in a

week and earn a $250 to $2,000 bonus, plus surprise rewards for top performers.



• Weekly ramp targets: Month 1, $40,000 collected. Month 2, $70,000. Month 3, $100,000, with 15

qualified bookings.



• Hit your ramp and you enter our 12-level Closer Ladder: a monthly base that grows at every level,

plus 10–12% commission that never goes down as you climb.



• At our $100,000-a-week target (Level 7), plan pay is about $50,800 a month. Our top level pays a

$15,000 monthly base plus 12% commission.



• Leadership track: lead a pod of closers for an override, then move into Sales Manager at a $100,000 base plus 1% of your team’s collected cash.



How we promote:



Every month, on your trailing 12-week results: collected cash, qualified bookings, show rate, chargeback

rate and CRM quality. No politics and no tenure clock. Produce, and you move up.



To apply:



Send your résumé, the name of the high-ticket program you completed, and your last 90 days of results

(calls, close rate and cash collected, with no client names). Shortlisted candidates complete a live

discovery-and-close role-play.

title: SEO Strategist
description:
HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, you must apply directly through our hiring portal using this link:





WHO WE ARE

Spark Marketing Agency is a fast growing digital marketing firm dedicated to scaling home service contractors across the US. We utilize data driven advertising, local SEO, and in house media production to build predictable revenue engines for our clients. Our commitment to operational excellence and real ROI over vanity metrics has allowed us to deliver measurable growth and keep our clients winning month after month. We are focused on turning ad spend into signed contracts while building a team of highly accountable, top tier professionals.



THE ROLE

You are the lead SEO strategist overseeing organic search performance across the entire agency, with a heavy emphasis on Local SEO and Google Business Profiles (GBP). You sit above our content writers and junior SEO teams and own rankings, traffic, and organic lead generation across 150+ contractor accounts.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Oversee all client SEO campaigns (on-page, off-page, technical, and local). Catch ranking drops before clients do. You own the outcome when a site loses visibility and know how to recover it.

* Set the agency standards for site architecture, local schema markup, keyword mapping, citation building, and GBP optimization.

* Train and coach junior SEOs and content creators. Review their optimization work weekly. Tell them what to change and why. Make them better every month.

* Run Spark's own SEO strategy to acquire new clients. This account directly funds the agency and gets your best work.

* Read Google Search Console and GA4 reports to diagnose what is actually broken technically or content-wise, not just what automated third-party audit tools say.

* Understand lead quality, not just traffic volume. You know the difference between ranking for a high-intent "plumber near me" keyword that books jobs and a national informational blog post that only inflates vanity traffic.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* Deep, proven mastery in Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, local service area pages, map pack rankings, and local link building). This is the absolute priority for this role.

* 3+ years managing SEO on the agency side, not client side.

* Real, proven experience driving organic leads for home services or contractor client accounts (plumbing, roofing, HVAC, remodeling, etc.). This is not negotiable. Ecommerce, info products, and SaaS experience do not transfer here.

* Track record of managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting smaller ones suffer.

* Deep comfort with technical SEO, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and WordPress architectures.

* Ability to audit site structures, identify indexing issues, and diagnose algorithmic penalties quickly.

* Prior experience training, reviewing, or managing other SEO specialists or writers.

* Clear, direct communication in writing and on calls. No scripts needed.

* Reliable internet and a computer that can handle a full workday.

* Commitment to working 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST (this is overnight in the Philippines and parts of Asia).



NICE TO HAVE

* Solid working knowledge of Google Ads and how paid and organic search integrate.

* Experience with GoHighLevel CRM and website builders.

* Prior work with programmatic SEO or advanced local landing page automation at scale.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR

* Someone who only knows how to run automated SEO audit tools and blindly exports PDF reports for clients.

* Someone who relies on spammy, outdated link-building tactics (PBNs, exact match anchor text stuffing) that put our clients' domains at risk.

* Someone who needs daily check ins or constant hand holding.

* Someone who blames Google core updates or algorithm shifts and throws their hands up when rankings drop.



We want someone who owns the organic number.



LOGISTICS

Full time independent contractor role, remote. You must be able to work from 9 a.m. PST to 6 p.m. PST reliably. Compensation is based on experience and demonstrated contractor account management at scale.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is reliable, responsive and professional.



The Administration Officer will often be the first point of contact for people contacting EduLink, so it is important that every caller receives a friendly and professional experience.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable long-term member of the EduLink team and take ownership of the administrative responsibilities assigned to them.

title: LTL Customer & Operations Representative
description:
LTL Customer & Operations Representative – Job Requirements



	• Minimum of two years of experience in LTL customer service and transportation operations.

	• Strong knowledge of LTL processes, including rate quotations, shipment tracking and tracing, documentation management, tariff regulations, freight classification, PCF calculations, rebills, claims, and customer disputes.

	• Proven ability to respond effectively to customer inquiries, rate requests, service concerns, and shipment exceptions in a timely and professional manner.

	• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple shipments, customer requests, and competing priorities simultaneously.

	• Proficient in TMS, Microsoft and Google applications.

	• Experienced in navigating LTL carrier websites and online portals to obtain real-time shipment tracking information and delivery updates.

	• Demonstrated attention to detail when entering and verifying shipment information, including origin and destination ZIP codes, pallet count, weight, dimensions, NMFC numbers, and freight classification.

	• Knowledgeable in identifying and applying appropriate accessorial services based on shipment and delivery requirements, including limited access, liftgate, inside delivery, residential delivery, and other specialized services.

	• Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

	• Reliable, responsive, and adaptable, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced transportation and logistics environment.

	• Bilingual proficiency in English is a MUST and Spanish is considered an asset.

 

Key Responsibilities:



	• Coordinate and monitor daily LTL shipments from initial pickup scheduling through final delivery.

	• Communicate shipment status, delays, exceptions, and other service-related issues to customers in a timely and professional manner.

	• Coordinate with LTL carriers and terminal personnel to facilitate effective track-and-trace activities and resolve shipment exceptions.

	• Accurately enter, update, and verify shipment information within the TMS to ensure data integrity and operational accuracy.

	• Assist customers with rate quotations, shipment scheduling, BOL preparation and distribution, tracking and tracing, and other transportation-related requests.

	• Address customer concerns and service issues promptly, escalating matters appropriately when additional support or management intervention is required.

	• Follow up on outstanding PODs and proactively identify, document, and communicate delivery exceptions.

	• Review carrier invoices and identify rate or billing discrepancies; update applicable rates, coordinate corrections or rebills, and obtain the necessary approvals.

title: STR Guest Experience Specialist
description:
OPERATIONS COORDINATOR



Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–4:00 PM ET | Remote | $7–$9/hour



ABOUT US



Exhale Vacation Rentals is a boutique short-term rental management company based in Palm Beach County, Florida. We manage a curated portfolio of high-end vacation rentals and pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional experience for our guests and homeowners.



We are a small, fast-moving team where everyone plays an important role in keeping the business running smoothly.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a highly proactive Operations Coordinator to join our team Monday–Friday from 8 AM–4 PM ET.



This is not a passive role and there is very little downtime. These are our busiest operational hours. You will be actively coordinating with guests, homeowners, vendors, property managers, and our field team throughout the day.



Your day could involve dispatching a plumber, troubleshooting an AC issue with a guest, ordering supplies, coordinating a delivery, helping a maintenance team member solve a problem, or finding a solution to an unexpected issue.



We need someone who can think on their feet, take initiative, prioritize, solve problems, and deliver exceptional customer service — without needing to be told exactly what to do.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Coordinate vendors and service providers and dispatch them to properties

* Troubleshoot guest and property issues and follow problems through to resolution

* Provide exceptional, thoughtful customer service to guests and homeowners

* Assist our field team with troubleshooting and operational support

* Communicate professionally with guests, homeowners, vendors, and team members

* Manage purchasing, deliveries, and property supplies

* Monitor property alerts and make sure issues don’t fall through the cracks

* Assist with property and listing audits

* Maintain TouchStay guides and other guest-facing information

* Respond to reviews and assist with guest experience initiatives

* Maintain operational trackers and administrative systems



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are:



* Experienced: 2+ years of professional work experience required

* A problem solver: You figure things out rather than waiting for instructions

* Self-directed: You are comfortable working independently and taking ownership

* Customer-service oriented: You understand what exceptional hospitality and service look like

* Calm under pressure: You can manage multiple issues and competing priorities

* Business-minded: You are comfortable communicating with clients, vendors, and service providers

* Highly organized: You have excellent follow-through and attention to detail

* A strong communicator: Excellent written and spoken English

* Resourceful: You are comfortable researching, troubleshooting, and making decisions



We value career growth and stability. If your résumé shows that you have been promoted or taken on increasing responsibility within the same company, please highlight that. A history of earning promotions is a strong indicator of the type of ownership and work ethic we are looking for.



Previous experience in business operations, hospitality, property management, vacation rentals, or a similar environment is preferred.



Experience with Airbnb, OwnerRez, Breezeway, Slack, Asana, or Google Workspace is a plus.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS



* Remote, full-time

* Monday–Friday, 8 AM–4 PM ET

* $7–$9/hour based on experience

* Contractor position

* PTO after 6 months

* Paid birthday leave

* Bonus opportunities

* Weekly pay every Friday



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume



2. A 2-minute video introduction



Don’t walk us through your resume. Tell us who you are, how you think, and why you would be a good fit for a fast-moving operations role.



3. Tell us about a time you had to solve a problem at work without being given the answer. Tell us what happened, what you did, and the outcome.



When reviewing your résumé, we will be specifically looking for career progression, including promotions or increased responsibility within a company.

title: Senior E-Commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist (AI + Performance Ads)
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING.

We are looking for an experienced E-Commerce Video Editor & Creative Strategist to work with multiple brands and products on an ongoing basis.

This is not an entry-level position.

Please DO NOT APPLY if you do not have at least 3–5 years of relevant editing experience, including proven experience creating video ads for e-commerce brands, DTC brands, or dropshipping businesses.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use AI tools or generate basic AI videos. We need someone who understands creative strategy, performance advertising, e-commerce, customer psychology, and how to turn an idea into a polished ad that is ready to be tested on platforms such as Meta.

You should be comfortable working across many different creative concepts and formats, including:

- UGC-style video ads

- Direct-response / performance ads

- AI-generated video and B-roll

- AI-assisted UGC

- Pixar-style / 3D animation concepts

- Product demonstrations

- Problem/solution concepts

- Storytelling and advertorial-style creatives

- Hooks and multiple ad variations

- Static image ads

- Other creative formats depending on the product and target audience

AI experience is required. You should already be comfortable working with modern AI image/video tools and know how to combine AI with professional editing to create convincing, high-quality commercial content.

WHAT WE EXPECT

You need to be highly creative and independent.

We do not want to explain every scene, transition, visual, hook, or piece of B-roll to you.

When you receive a product, brief, script, or idea, we expect you to research the product, understand the target customer and market, study relevant competitors/ads when necessary, and develop strong creative ideas yourself.

You should be able to look at a product and think:

“What angles can we test? What hooks could stop this audience? What creative formats make sense for this product? How can I turn this into an ad worth testing?”

We want someone who actively brings ideas to the table instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.

You should also understand that a beautiful video is not necessarily a good advertisement. The objective is to create high-quality creatives designed to generate sales and be tested for performance.

IMPORTANT — DO NOT APPLY IF:

Please do not apply if:

- You have less than 3 years of relevant professional experience.

- Your portfolio mainly consists of random AI generations, personal experiments, generic animations, or non-commercial projects.

- You have little or no experience creating ads for e-commerce/DTC brands.

- You depend heavily on ChatGPT/Claude or AI tools to tell you what to create.

- You need detailed instructions for every scene.

- You cannot independently research a product and its target audience.

- You have never worked with multiple advertising concepts and formats.

- You cannot show real, relevant e-commerce advertising work in your portfolio.

Knowing how to operate AI software is not the same as being an experienced creative editor.

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to combine editing + AI + advertising + creative strategy + e-commerce into one complete workflow.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

When applying, please include:

1. How many years have you professionally edited e-commerce/performance advertising?

2. Which e-commerce/DTC brands or products have you worked with?

3. Send 3–5 of your BEST e-commerce video ads. Do not send your entire portfolio.

4. Which AI video/image tools do you currently use professionally?

5. Briefly explain your role in the examples you send. Did you develop the concept yourself, or were you given exact instructions?

6. Have any of your creatives generated measurable sales or been scaled by a client? If yes, briefly explain. Please do not invent performance numbers.

7. Start your application with the word “NOVA”. Applications that do not start with NOVA will not be considered.

That last requirement is intentional. It immediately removes many people who mass-apply without even reading the job description.

PAID TEST

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical editing test.

The test will be based on the type of work you would actually be doing with us.

Passing the test is required before moving forward. A strong portfolio alone does not guarantee the position.

We will evaluate:

Creative thinking • Editing quality • E-commerce understanding • AI execution • Attention to detail • Ability to work independently • Communication • Final ad quality

COMPENSATION

Starting rate: $3–$4 USD/hour

There will also be a performance-based bonus structure tied to the results generated by the creatives.

The initial period will be used to evaluate the quality and consistency of your work. If the collaboration performs well and your creatives produce strong results, there will be opportunities to increase the hourly rate and earn additional performance bonuses.

We are looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration, not a one-off editing project.

title: Cruise & Guest Services Specialist (Full-Time, Remote, EST)
description:
Another position opened, as we are continuing to add to the team--Cruise & Guest Services Virtual Assistant / Specialist 



Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Eastern Time (EST) 



Starting Rate: $5/hour 

Schedule: 40 hours/week 

Growth Opportunity: Performance-based increases 



About Us 



We are a boutique travel agency based in Atlanta, GA (EST). We specialize in luxury river cruises — especially Viking and now AmaWaterways — and offer white-glove support for discerning clients. 

 

We're warm, organized, and passionate about creating unforgettable cruise experiences. Our team is small, collaborative, and committed to doing things right. 

 

We have documented processes (SOPs) for most tasks, so you won't be guessing. You'll be trained and supported, not thrown into the deep end. 

 

We're looking for a talented Virtual Assistant to join us full-time. 

 

Before You Apply: 



This Role Is Likely a Great Fit If: 



You have cruise guest services experience or strong travel booking experience 



You have supported luxury or high-touch clients 



You enjoy detailed administrative work 



You want a stable, long-term remote position 



You can confidently communicate with senior clients 



You take ownership of your work and ask questions when needed 



DO NOT Apply If: 



Your experience is limited to general hospitality roles such as bartending, serving, retail, or unrelated customer service positions 



You are not comfortable speaking with clients on the phone, and couldn't be understood clearly with senior & elderly clients.



You are looking for freelance, temporary, or part-time work 



You cannot commit to U.S. Eastern Time business hours 



You submit generic applications without reviewing the requirements (we can always tell which is AI--all cover letters have the same phrases! Just be yourself).

 



Role Snapshot 



As our Virtual Assistant, you'll be responsible for: 



Speaking with clients on the phone 



Drafting client emails (hold reminders, confirmation, follow-ups, courtesy responses, answer inquiries) 



Updating HubSpot CRM and internal trackers — keeping booking statuses, contact details, and notes current 



Calling Viking Cruises and clients to verify information, request itineraries, or resolve booking questions 



Supporting the CEO and team with high-level administrative tasks 



Managing booking coordination from inquiry through post-travel follow-up 



Expectation: 



You'll work directly with our staff as internal support — not as an independent agent. 



Guest/client emails are drafts for review. 



You'll have autonomy for routine messages, with clear guidance on when to escalate (pricing, payments, sensitive situations). 



Some responses require an empathetic, reassuring tone; others follow standard templates. 



You'll be trained on our systems (HubSpot, booking trackers, Outlook) and supported by an experienced team invested in your success. 

 



Who We're Looking For 



Must-Have Qualifications 



Experience in cruise guest services, travel bookings, or itinerary 



Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, polished, professional tone 



Comfortable speaking with clients on the phone 



Ability to work independently and manage detailed tasks remotely 



High attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability 



Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace 



Executive Assistant experience involving complex travel coordination may also qualify. 



Bonus Points 



River cruise experience 



Familiarity with Viking or AmaWaterways 



Experience using the MyViking Journey (MVJ) Travel Advisor Portal or AmaWaterways 



HubSpot CRM experience (or fast learner with CRMs) 



Experience with booking portals, invoices, or guest information systems 



Strong time management and comfort with documented SOP 



Schedule 



Target Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST 



For applicants in the Philippines, this is an evening/night shift schedule. Please ensure this works for you before applying. 



Hours may vary based on business needs. 



Saturday coverage may occasionally be required after training and will be handled through team rotation. 



How to Apply 



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We use this process to assess attention to detail, communication skills, and genuine interest in the role. 



Step 1 



Include the phrase: "Smooth Sailing" in your subject line or opening sentence. 



Step 2 



Submit a 1–2 minute video introduction (Required). Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed. 



Your video should: 



Explain your relevant cruise guest services or travel booking experience 



Share why you're passionate about travel support or river cruising 



Describe what excites you about working with a team like ours 



Step 3 



Attach your resume/CV. (If using Google Drive, ensure access is granted) 



We're excited to meet someone who genuinely cares about delivering excellent travel service and wants to grow with a supportive team. 



If that sounds like you — smooth sailing ahead. 

(Please note, due to the volume of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted)

title: FULL-TIME LONG-FORM & SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Full-Time Remote Position  

Schedule: 40 hours per week  

Compensation: $1,200–$1,600 USD per month based on experience, portfolio and paid-trial performance  

Long-term position



ABOUT US



The McGraw Group is a husband-and-wife real estate business led by Torrey and Keela McGraw. We serve clients throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth region.



Video is an important part of how we grow our business, educate our audience and attract real estate clients.



Our content includes:



- DFW relocation guidance

- Mansfield real estate

- Neighborhood and city comparisons

- New construction

- Housing-market information

- Local developments

- Home and community tours

- Property listings

- Client-success stories

- Behind-the-scenes content

- Keela and Torrey’s personalities and perspectives

- McGraw Group brand content



Keela is currently our primary on-camera host, but this position supports the entire McGraw Group. Videos may feature Keela, Torrey, both of us together, clients, properties, communities or local businesses.



ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for a full-time video editor who can handle both long-form YouTube content and short-form social-media content.



This is not a per-video freelance position.



You will be a regular member of our team, and video editing will be your primary professional responsibility. We want someone who will learn our brand, understand our audience, recognize our individual personalities and help us develop a consistent but flexible editing style.



This is a salaried, full-time position. There is no fixed monthly cap on the number of videos you may edit.



You will manage the reasonable editing workload that fits within a 40-hour workweek. Weekly priorities will be based on publishing deadlines, business needs and project complexity.



We value quality and reliability. We do not expect rushed work, unlimited revisions or an unreasonable workload. We do expect full-time focus, honest communication and consistent completion of agreed priorities.



CURRENT CONTENT CADENCE



Our current long-form YouTube goal is two videos per week:



- One informational, relocation, development, market or neighborhood video

- One home or community tour



You will also edit short-form content throughout the week for:



- Instagram Reels

-
 Reels

- TikTok

- YouTube Shorts

- Listing campaigns

- Client case studies

- Testimonials

- Local news and development updates

- Keela and Torrey’s personal-brand content

- McGraw Group promotional content



The short-form workload will vary based on our content calendar, available footage, listings, closings, local news and business activity.



LONG-FORM RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit informational YouTube videos

- Edit home and community tours

- Strengthen the opening 30–60 seconds

- Remove mistakes, repetition and unnecessary pauses

- Improve pacing while keeping the speaker’s delivery natural

- Shape footage into a clear and compelling story

- Identify sections that should be shortened, rearranged or visually supported

- Find relevant B-roll when it is not provided

- Use maps and location visuals when helpful

- Display important facts, prices, locations and statistics clearly

- Add clean on-screen text and graphics

- Clean and balance audio

- Perform consistent color correction

- Select appropriate licensed music

- Use sound design tastefully

- Add provided disclosures or disclaimers

- Complete revisions accurately

- Export platform-ready files

- Organize and transfer editable project files



INFORMATIONAL VIDEO STYLE



Informational videos should:



- Capture attention quickly

- Be easy for relocation viewers to understand

- Use B-roll that directly supports the narration

- Use maps and graphics when they provide meaningful context

- Maintain visual interest without becoming distracting

- Feel professional, current and trustworthy

- Preserve the speaker’s personality and natural delivery

- Help viewers make real decisions about Dallas–Fort Worth



Subjects may include:



- DFW suburb comparisons

- Mansfield developments

- Housing-market changes

- Relocation decisions

- Neighborhood differences

- New construction

- Buyer and seller education

- Property taxes, PIDs and MUDs

- What different budgets purchase

- Regional news affecting homeowners and buyers



HOME AND COMMUNITY TOUR STYLE



Tour videos should:



- Showcase the property clearly

- Preserve a natural sense of movement through the home

- Feature our personalities and useful commentary

- Highlight important property and community details

- Include facts without cluttering the screen

- Use exterior, amenity and neighborhood footage when relevant

- Feel polished without being overedited

- Help viewers learn more than they could from listing photographs



Tours may include:



- Selfie-style hooks and introductions

- Point-of-view walkthrough footage

- Keela or Torrey speaking inside the property

- Conversations between Keela and Torrey

- Community amenities

- Builder information

- New-construction considerations

- Buyer guidance

- Calls to action



SHORT-FORM RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit original social-first videos

- Repurpose appropriate long-form footage

- Edit direct-to-camera phone videos

- Turn informal phone footage into polished content

- Edit listing and property Reels

- Create local-news and development videos

- Edit client-success and case-study videos

- Create behind-the-scenes content

- Edit conversations between Keela and Torrey

- Add accurate burned-in captions

- Create strong visual openings

- Use pattern changes when they improve retention

- Format videos for 9:16 viewing

- Follow platform safe zones

- Use platform-appropriate pacing

- Select appropriate B-roll and music

- Deliver clean files without platform watermarks

- Create alternate opening hooks when requested



Some short-form videos will come from long-form footage. Others will be created specifically for social media.



You should be comfortable turning the following into effective content:



- Selfie videos

- Voiceovers

- Property footage

- Community footage

- Photographs

- Screenshots

- Maps

- Interviews

- Client testimonials

- Behind-the-scenes clips

- Unorganized phone footage

- Conversations between multiple people



ENGLISH-LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT



Excellent English is required for this position.



You must be able to:



- Understand conversational American English

- Understand different speaking speeds and natural speech patterns

- Recognize humor, tone, emphasis and intended meaning

- Understand real estate and location-related terminology

- Identify statements that may need clarification

- Write clearly and professionally in English

- Communicate confidently during team meetings

- Create accurate English captions

- Correct obvious captioning and transcription errors

- Recognize awkward grammar

- Understand detailed written and verbal instructions

- Ask clear follow-up questions

- Distinguish between words that sound similar

- Accurately spell names, cities, communities, builders and real estate terms



We should not have to rewrite captions because the editor did not understand what was said.



EDITORIAL JUDGMENT



We do not want an editor who only follows instructions mechanically.



You should be able to recognize:



- A weak opening

- Unnecessary repetition

- A section that needs B-roll

- A factual statement that may need an on-screen source

- Footage that does not match the narration

- A moment that could become a strong short-form video

- A section that moves too slowly

- A section that has been overedited

- An opportunity to better showcase someone’s personality

- A potential factual or visual inconsistency

- A caption that does not match what the speaker said



If something is unclear or possibly inaccurate, ask before publishing it.



OUR PREFERRED STYLE



Our videos should feel:



- Professional

- Conversational

- Modern

- Visually engaging

- Informative

- Personality-led

- Appropriate for real estate and relocation viewers



We want editing that helps the viewer understand the subject and connect with the people on screen.



PLEASE AVOID



- Excessive transitions

- Constant zooming

- Distracting sound effects

- Unrelated luxury footage

- Generic stock footage that does not match DFW

- Meme-style editing unless specifically requested

- Full-time captions covering an entire long-form video

- Overly cinematic editing that slows the story

- Repetitive templates

- Making every Reel look identical

- Graphics that overwhelm the person or property

- Inventing facts, statistics or property details

- Copying another creator’s exact style



B-ROLL AND ASSET RESEARCH



You will often receive footage, photographs, scripts and source links.



You will also be expected to:



- Find additional commercially licensed B-roll

- Locate appropriate geographic and lifestyle visuals

- Organize downloaded assets

- Track the source of third-party footage and music

- Avoid footage that misrepresents a city or community

- Confirm when an asset requires a separate license

- Use maps accurately

- Maintain a reusable library of approved McGraw Group footage



All music, video, photographs and graphics must be properly licensed for commercial use.



WORKFLOW AND COLLABORATION



You will work with Torrey, Keela and other members of our content team.



You will be expected to:



- Review each project brief

- Confirm that required assets were received

- Communicate questions early

- Provide realistic completion dates

- Maintain the project tracker

- Submit drafts for review

- Complete revisions on time

- Keep project files organized

- Follow agreed naming conventions

- Build reusable editing systems

- Help maintain a publishing backlog

- Participate in scheduled team meetings

- Communicate immediately if a deadline is at risk



We do not want to discover on publication day that a video will not be completed.



WORKLOAD AND PRIORITIES



This is a salaried, full-time position—not a per-video contract.



Some weeks may contain more short-form videos. Other weeks may contain more complex long-form projects.



Weekly priorities will generally follow this order:



1. Scheduled long-form YouTube videos

2. Time-sensitive listings and local news

3. Original social-first videos

4. Short-form repurposing

5. Case studies and evergreen content

6. Older-video improvements and special projects



If the assigned workload cannot be completed at the expected quality within the available hours, communicate that early so priorities can be adjusted.



NORMAL TURNAROUND EXPECTATIONS



Turnaround will depend on project complexity, but typical expectations include:



- Informational-video first cut: four to five business days

- Home-tour first cut: three to four business days

- Standard short-form edit: one to two business days

- Routine revisions: approximately one business day

- Larger revisions: timeline agreed upon after reviewing the request



REQUIRED SKILLS



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong English listening comprehension

- Strong long-form YouTube editing

- Strong short-form vertical editing

- Strong pacing and storytelling

- Understanding of hooks and viewer retention

- Ability to edit content featuring different personalities

- Ability to find relevant B-roll

- Audio cleanup and sound mixing

- Color correction

- Accurate English captioning

- Basic motion graphics

- Map and location graphics

- File and asset organization

- Ability to follow brand guidelines

- Ability to work without constant supervision

- Reliable internet connection

- A computer capable of handling long-form projects

- Professional editing software



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Real estate videos

- Relocation or location-based content

- Home and community tours

- Educational YouTube content

- Personal-brand content

- Listing Reels

- Client testimonials

- Local-news videos

- Multi-person or conversational videos

- Remote content teams

- YouTube retention analysis

- Creating reusable editing systems



EMPLOYMENT EXPECTATIONS



This should be your primary full-time professional commitment.



You may not maintain another full-time job that conflicts with this position. Any ongoing clients or regular side projects must be disclosed before hiring and must not interfere with our deadlines, meetings or work quality.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the McGraw Group team—not someone trying to fit our projects between numerous unrelated clients.



PERFORMANCE WILL BE EVALUATED ON



- Long-form quality

- Short-form quality

- Strength of hooks and pacing

- Ability to preserve each speaker’s personality

- English comprehension

- Caption accuracy

- Attention to detail

- On-time delivery

- Revision accuracy

- Communication

- File organization

- B-roll judgment

- Ability to identify strong short-form moments

- Consistency across different video formats

- Amount of supervision required



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $1,200–$1,600 USD per month

- Final compensation based on experience, portfolio and paid-trial performance

- Some scheduled overlap with U.S. Central Time required

- 90-day performance and compensation review

- Long-term position for the right person



STYLE REFERENCES



We will provide selected examples of:



- Our strongest informational videos

- Our strongest home and community tours

- Informational videos from other channels

- Tour videos with pacing and visual presentation we like

- Short-form videos that demonstrate the quality and tone we want



These references communicate quality, pacing and storytelling. We do not want another creator’s wording, graphics or editing copied.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the first sentence of your application with this exact phrase:



“GREAT EDITING STARTS WITH UNDERSTANDING THE STORY.”



Applications that do not begin with this exact phrase will not be considered.



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction written in your own words

2. Your resume

3. Your long-form YouTube portfolio

4. Your short-form vertical portfolio

5. At least two informational or educational videos you edited

6. At least two personality-led short-form videos you edited

title: DIRECTOR OF OPS AND FINANCE
description:
THE ROLE



Your job in one sentence: protect revenue.



You own the financial and operational outcome of the business. Your job is to run cash, inventory, and fulfillment so well that the founder never has to step into ops or finance, because every hour he spends there is an hour not spent on product and marketing, which is where the company grows.



Your score is one number: Total Operational Loss, the sum of the three costs you control. Cancels caused by lead times, shipping to customers, and freight to the USA including reships and replacement parts. Every week you predict it, then beat your prediction.



This is not a reporting role. Reports are the exhaust of the job, not the job. You plan what gets paid and when, you keep inventory landing before we stock out and after we can afford it, you push suppliers and the 3PL when they slip, and you bring the founder decisions with your recommendation attached, not problems without options.



You will work daily with the founder, our systems lead, our payments coordinator, our CS team, our 3PL, and our factories.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN: FINANCE



--> The 25-week rolling cash flow model: multi-scenario, assumption-driven, synced to the inventory tracker, with every week's low point visible before it arrives



--> Bill payments: you d
 and dictate what gets paid, when, and what gets pushed or negotiated. You issue the weekly payment sheet that the team executes wires from. The founder approves in one look on Slack. Nobody plans payments but you, and no bill moves off your schedule without you flagging what it does to the projection



--> Loan and financing management: Shopify Capital, Wayflyer, supplier terms, including modeling repayment schedules before we sign, not after



--> Supplier payment negotiation: deposits, Net terms, and holding suppliers to the projection instead of quietly absorbing their timing



--> Sales and demand modeling: regressions on Shopify data to size orders and set revenue expectations



--> Cash turnover and downside scenarios: what comes back each week when we sell, and what breaks at 85 percent of plan



--> Sales tax, duties, and tariff tracking with our accountants





WHAT YOU WILL OWN: OPERATIONS



--> Inventory planning end to end: factory orders sized and timed against runway, ocean freight booked at lowest landed cost, containers mapped to warehouses, the inventory tracker kept live



--> Supplier management: quotes, POs, deposits, production follow-ups, and escalating when a factory or vendor goes quiet



--> 3PL performance: receiving events checked in on time, priority orders shipped inside 48 hours, backorder allocation, and daily escalation when they slip



--> Fulfillment economics and trade-off math: sometimes spending more in one column saves the total, like shipping only from Arizona at higher cost to cut lead times when the cancels prevented cost more than the extra shipping. Every recommendation comes with cost added per order and cost per day saved



--> CS operations interface: allocation of constrained stock, cancel-rate reduction tied to lead times, and keeping the cancel backlog shrinking. You answer five questions cold, without opening a file: are we gaining or losing days of stock, how is ship-to-customer trending, how is landed cost trending, how are cancels trending, and how are we preserving revenue across all four



--> Freight quotes and duty planning for every inbound container





HOW YOU WILL WORK



--> AI-first for systems, manual for accountability: every workflow runs through Claude before the old way, and if AI cannot do something you try at least 20 approaches before calling it blocked. But your weekly numbers and your "what I am doing about it" are typed by you, in your own words. Automated AI reports do not get read and do not get felt. You have to physically know your numbers.



--> Done means excellent, shipped, and visible. "Almost done" is not a status. Work the founder never sees did not happen.



--> Weekly cadence: Tuesday morning review call (ops, finance, CS) where you present. Friday written recap of what shipped, hours saved, experiments running, and what you need.



--> Decisions travel with options: when you are stuck, you bring what you tried, the choices, and your recommendation. Never a problem without options.



--> Numbers get verified to source. A model is checked against the bank balance, the loan offer sheet, and the tracker before anyone d
 on it. Errors get documented so they are not repeated.



--> You push back out loud. When a supplier, a bill, or a teammate breaks the plan, you flag it the day it happens instead of silently adjusting the model.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-haves:



--> 3+ years running ops or finance for an ecommerce or DTC brand with physical inventory: you have placed factory orders, booked ocean freight, and lived through a cash crunch



--> Strong spreadsheet modeling: you can build a driver-based cash flow model with live formulas, defend every number in it, and find the broken sum in someone else's



--> Supplier and 3PL management experience, including uncomfortable negotiations over terms and timing



--> Daily, fluent AI use: you already work with Claude or similar tools and can show something real you built with them



--> Excellent written English: most decisions here happen in Slack, in short clear writing



--> Ownership and strategic proactivity: you have run a function where the outcome was yours, not just the tasks. The bar here is manager, not assistant: you see the big picture and arrive at the problems yourself, before anyone names them for you



You are not a fit if:



--> You need detailed instructions before starting, or wait to be unblocked instead of trying another way



--> Your instinct when a number is off is to adjust quietly rather than raise it



--> You prefer deep work in private over showing unfinished work early



--> You see AI as a threat or a shortcut rather than the way the job is done





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: you know every supplier, loan, container, and payment by name and can answer the five questions cold. You run the weekly payment plan and the Tuesday review without help. Your Total Operational Loss scorecard is
 the number, the three columns, your prediction, and what you are doing about it, every Friday. The cash flow model is verified to source and you have found at least one thing wrong with it.



By 60 days: inventory orders are placed on your recommendation. The founder approves your plans in one look instead of building them with you. The operational efficiency score is reported weekly and climbing.



By 90 days: the founder has not been pulled into an ops or finance fire for a month. Cash low points are flagged weeks ahead with options attached. You have systematized at least three recurring workflows with AI and can show the hours saved.





COMPENSATION



--> Salary: USD 2,500 per month, full time, remote



--> Hours: substantial overlap with US Eastern mornings required for the weekly review and founder calls



--> Performance upside: team members who own outcomes share in company-wide incentive pools when we win



--> Tools provided: Claude, Slack, Google Workspace, Shopify, and whatever else the job needs





HOW TO APPLY



Send the following. Applications missing any item will not be read.



1. A short note on the hardest cash or inventory decision you have owned: the numbers, what you chose, and what happened



2. One spreadsheet model you built yourself, with a paragraph on how you verified it



3. One concrete example of a workflow you automated or ran with AI, with before and after



4. Your earliest available start date

title: Executive Assistant & Client Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

You’ll be the operating backbone for the company’s leadership team. The largest part of the job is classic executive support: calendars, meetings, inboxes, and follow-through for the company’s two co-founders. The second part is coordinating how new clients get started, so the customer success team can spend its time with clients instead of chasing calendars. You will be a working member of the team, not a task queue. You will learn how the company operates and get to know the clients.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Executive and leadership support

• Own the calendars for both co-founders: schedule, reschedule, protect focus time, and resolve conflicts across time zones.

• Coordinate meetings with clients, prospects, partners, investors, and vendors, including sending invites, confirming attendees, and sharing agendas and materials ahead of time.

• Triage and draft
 responses, keep follow-ups from slipping, and track open action items after meetings.

• Prepare meeting briefs and pull together notes, summaries, and next steps from recorded calls.

• Over time, extend the same support to other members of the leadership team.



2. Client kickoff and project coordination

• When a new client signs, run the kickoff logistics, identify the key people on the client side and on the company side, and make sure everyone knows their role.

• Send intake surveys and questionnaires to new clients to gather details about their company, team, and goals, then follow up until they are complete.

• Work with each client to map out their onboarding meeting plan: which sessions are needed, what each one covers, when it should happen, and who needs to attend.

• Get that full meeting plan on the calendar with the client and keep it on track as dates move.

• Follow up with clients after each meeting: send recaps and next steps, and chase open items, surveys, and action items until they are done.

• Take the bulk of scheduling work off our customer success lead so he can stay focused on the client relationship.

• Keep simple, accurate records of where each client is in onboarding and flag anything that is stuck.



3. Internal operations

• Help with general internal coordination beyond calendars and
, such as tracking product activation for new clients, organizing shared files, and keeping team documentation current.

• Spot repeat work and suggest better ways to handle it.

• Pick up ad hoc projects as the company grows.



Requirements

• 3+ years as an executive assistant, project coordinator, operations coordinator, or similar role supporting senior leaders.

• Strong command of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook calendar and
, Teams, and SharePoint.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will write directly to our clients, who are business owners and technology leaders in the US.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling many moving pieces for several people at once.

• Proactive. You follow up without being asked and raise problems early.

• Sound judgment with confidential information.

• Able to work consistently during US Eastern business hours.



Nice to Have

• Experience at a startup or small, fast-moving company.

• Experience coordinating client onboarding or implementation projects at a software, SaaS, or IT services company.

• Familiarity with the MSP or IT services industry.

• Experience with project or ticket tracking tools (we use Linear) and meeting recording tools (we use Avoma).



Tools

• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint)

• Claude

• Linear

• Avoma

• Company’s own platform

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. title: Professional Animator Needed - Paid 30-second Trail Required
description:
Professional 2D Anime Animator Needed I am hiring an experienced 2D animator or animation team for an original, mature-rated anime series.

I already have the characters and can provide character bibles, scripts, scene directions, backgrounds, wardrobe, weapon references, and other production information. 



Required Quality 

Only apply if you can produce professional animation comparable in quality, movement, and intensity to: 

* The Boondocks 

* Hellsing Ultimate 

* Black Lagoon 

* Tokyo Ghoul 

* Attack on Titan 



These are quality references only. All work must be original. 



The series includes graphic blood, violence, firearms, weapon usage, injuries, fight scenes, and mature themes. Do not apply if you are uncomfortable animating this content. 



Portfolio Required 

You must provide a relevant animation portfolio showing character movement, action, fight scenes, cinematic camera work, or completed animated scenes. 



Illustration-only portfolios will not qualify. Applications without relevant professional animation samples will be declined.



Paid 30- Second Trial Test - $150



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid 30-second trial for $150. It will not include dialogue or lip-sync but may include action, character movement, weapons, blood effects, backgrounds, camera movement, and sound effects. 

Any sound effects must be original or legally licensed for commercial use. YouTube audio without confirmed usage rights is prohibited. 



AI-generated animation, AI-generated drawings, AI-generated in-between frames, AI-generated backgrounds, or AI-assisted work is not permitted unless explicitly approved in writing beforehand.



The trial includes one reasonable revision round based on creative direction.

An applicant hired for the full production may receive an additional $50 welcome bonus. 



Required Trial Files 

An MP4 alone will not be accepted. You must submit: 

* Final animation export 

* Editable native project files 

* Storyboard and animatic 

* Roughs, keyframes, breakdowns, and in-betweens 

* Original drawings and separated layers 

* Backgrounds, props, weapons, and effects 

*Rigs and reusable assets, if used 

*Compositions and audio stems 

*Fonts, plug-ins, and linked assets required to open the project 

*Organized folders and handoff notes 



Files must be organized so another animator can open the project, continue production, reuse assets, or revise previous work without starting over.



You must be comfortable collaborating with other artists and working within an established production pipeline. This project may involve coordinating with storyboard artists, background artists, animators, compositors, sound designers, and other team members to ensure a consistent, high-quality final product.





You may be required to provide progress files, timeline screenshots, layer structures, or a short workspace recording proving you created the submitted work. Stolen, traced, AI-generated, or secretly subcontracted work will be disqualified. 



Ownership and Agreement 

Before starting, the animator must sign an Animation Development Agreement (ADA) and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). 



All work created, provided, or submitted specifically for the paid trial or series—including drafts, drawings, animation, rigs, backgrounds, effects, reusable assets, and project files—will belong exclusively to me upon payment. I may edit, continue, reproduce, publish, monetize, and use that work without additional permission or payment. 



Project materials may not be reused, sold, shared, leaked, subcontracted, or posted publicly without my written permission. No copyrighted third-party materials may be used without approved commercial rights. 



To Apply 

Please provide: 

1. Your animation portfolio 

2. Your best action or cinematic animation sample 

3. The software you use 

4. Your location, time zone, and availability 

5. Whether you work alone or with a team 

6. Your rate for continued production 

7. Confirmation that you accept the $150 trial 

8. Confirmation that you will provide all editable source files 

9. Confirmation that you will sign the ADA and NDA 



Begin your application with “SOURCE FILES INCLUDED” so I know you read the complete posting.

title: Job Opportunity: Instagram Content Designer / Carousel Editor | Remote | Freelance
description:
Are you creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about designing high-quality Instagram content? Then we might be looking for you!



We are Brandshippers, a Dutch e-commerce coaching company that helps entrepreneurs build their own online businesses through bol.com, one of the largest online marketplaces in the Netherlands and Belgium.



We are looking for a talented Instagram Content Designer who can help us create professional, engaging, and visually appealing Instagram content.



Our goal is to strengthen our Instagram presence and create content that reflects our brand identity while educating, inspiring, and engaging our audience.



About the Job



As our Instagram Content Designer, you will be responsible for designing different types of Instagram posts for Brandshippers.



Your work may include:



Instagram carousels consisting of multiple slides that tell a complete story.

Educational and informative posts about e-commerce.

Visual content explaining our coaching programs.

Posts showcasing client results and testimonials.

Other creative content that aligns with our brand identity and target audience.



We will provide the necessary information, copy, and content ideas. Your responsibility will be to transform these materials into professional, visually appealing Instagram posts.



You should be able to work independently, contribute creative ideas, and understand how to present information in a clear and engaging visual format.



3-Week Trial Period



We will start with a three-week trial period to determine whether we are a good fit and whether your work meets our expectations.



During this period, we expect:



4 Instagram posts per week for 3 consecutive weeks.



This means a total of 12 Instagram posts during the trial period.



Please note that an Instagram carousel counts as ONE post, regardless of the number of slides it contains.



For example:



1 single-image post = 1 Instagram post.

1 carousel containing 5 slides = 1 Instagram post.

1 carousel containing 8 slides = 1 Instagram post.



A carousel containing five slides does NOT count as five separate Instagram posts.



We will discuss the different types of content and the weekly content schedule together.



After the trial period, we will evaluate the collaboration and discuss the possibility of working together long-term.



What We're Looking For

Experience designing Instagram content, preferably for businesses, personal brands, or online coaching companies.

Strong skills in Figma, Canva, or similar design software.

Experience creating professional and engaging Instagram carousels.

A strong understanding of branding, typography, color combinations, and visual consistency.

The ability to turn information into creative, well-structured visual content.

The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Good English communication skills.

A positive, proactive attitude and willingness to receive feedback.

Availability to create four Instagram posts per week.



Important: All communication with our team will take place through WhatsApp. You must be comfortable using WhatsApp for communication, feedback, and discussing assignments.



Compensation



Compensation is negotiable and will be discussed based on your experience, skills, and expected rates.



We are open to different pricing arrangements, such as payment per post, per carousel, or a fixed rate for an agreed amount of content.



Please share your expected rates when applying.



What We Offer

Fully remote work.

A clear three-week trial period.

A flexible working arrangement with room for creativity.

Direct and personal communication with our team through WhatsApp.

The opportunity to build a long-term working relationship with Brandshippers.

The possibility to grow alongside our company and take on additional creative responsibilities in the future.

How to Apply



Interested in becoming our Instagram Content Designer?



Please send us the following:



Your portfolio, including examples of Instagram posts and carousels you have designed.

A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience.

The design software you use (Figma, Canva, or similar).

Your expected rate per post, per carousel, or for a fixed number of posts.

Confirmation that you are available to create four Instagram posts per week and can communicate through WhatsApp.



We would especially love to see examples of professional Instagram carousels similar to the style we are looking for.



We look forward to reviewing your application and hopefully creating great content together!



Team Brandshippers

title: Grok Bot Dev Lead (Part-Time, 20 hours per week)
description:
About the opportunity



We are a growing US-based business training and media company, and we are looking for a skilled Grok Bot Development Lead. This role owns the AI bot system that finds, scores, and opens conversations with community and event owners so our team can interview them. The bots find and open. People still make the calls, run the interviews, and teach. You build and run the machine that feeds them.



What you will do



Build and maintain two Grok Bots in a dedicated internal workspace: a Researcher that finds, scores, and tracks prospects, and an Opener that drafts and, after human approval, sends
 and LinkedIn messages. Neither bot ever phones or joins a video call.

Write and maintain the standing orders for each bot, including explicit guard rules covering what each bot must never do, and fail any draft that breaks them.

Enrich and score one assigned prospect group from a targeting blueprint, capturing name, title, organization,
, LinkedIn, phone where available, latest public topic, a verbatim public quote, warm relationship flag, decision maker plus up to two lieutenants, and the events contact. Score zero to five against a published rubric and release only the top tier, roughly twenty organizations for the live test rather than two hundred.

Keep every contact's pipeline stage current in GoHighLevel, from first request through called, booked, interviewed, and closed states. GoHighLevel is the only source of truth. No side spreadsheet.

Wire the GoHighLevel intake form and the group-labeled calendar link so the booking, the prep fields, and the status card all agree, then test the whole flow yourself as a prospect would experience it.

Hold send discipline: daily caps per channel, staggered
 and LinkedIn to the same person, one follow-up and then stop, and an immediate channel freeze plus supervisor alert if bounces or platform warnings spike.

Queue drafts for supervisor approval before sending, log subject, body variant, channel, and result, and bring a weekly short list of which copy to keep and which to retire.

Produce the one-page pre-interview brief the same day a slot books, and send a nightly written note to the supervisor covering asks, replies, bookings, no-shows, and next actions.



Schedule and setup



Hours: 20 hours per week

Working hours: the business operates 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific time. You choose which 20 hours you work inside that window, and you keep the same schedule week to week so the supervisor knows when to expect you. For applicants in the Philippines this is a night shift, roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila time

Setup: reliable internet and a dedicated computer for the bot workspace. The approved sending Gmail and an approved test LinkedIn profile are provided. Personal accounts are never used for outreach



Must-have skills and tools



Hands-on experience building and operating AI agents or bots: standing orders, group chats, send queues, connected
 accounts, guard rules

GoHighLevel: pipelines, stages, forms, calendars, contact records

List enrichment and prospect scoring against a written rubric

Writing instructions precise enough for a bot to obey, with a clear line between what it does and what it must not do

 and LinkedIn deliverability fundamentals: sending caps, staggering, follow-up limits, and when to freeze a channel

Ability to follow a tight build brief without redesigning the project

Escalates in writing with a proposed option the same day, not with a verbal debug dump

Strong written English



Nice to have



Direct experience inside Grok Bot workspaces

Gmail deliverability and domain warm-up experience

Experience supporting interview, podcast, or speaker booking outreach



Compensation



USD 650 per month for 20 hours per week.



How to apply

Apply here and Include the words "standing order" in the first line of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: VEGAS PRO Editor for Compilation Videos - Long-Term

We're looking for someone dependable who wants a stable, long-term editing position and is willing to learn and improve with us.

eting setup and logistics

title: Social Media Expert
description:
## Part-Time Video-First Social Media Manager

**20 Hours/Week | Remote | $7 USD/Hour | Long-Term Position**



We are looking for a talented, creative, dependable **Video-First Social Media Manager** in the Philippines to join us approximately **20 hours per week**.



We are a Christian marketplace ministry serving business owners, executives, professionals and younger business leaders. Our mission is to help men connect their **faith, work and relationships** and become better leaders in business, family and life.



This is NOT primarily a graphic-design or administrative VA position.



**Video is the priority.**



### What You'll Do



You will take raw videos, interviews, teachings, event footage and other content and turn them into compelling social-media content.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Edit long-form video into engaging **30–90 second short-form videos**

- Identify the strongest moments without always being told which sections to use

- Create strong opening hooks that capture attention

- Add captions, titles, B-roll, music and transitions when appropriate

- Create Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn videos

- Create simple thumbnails and graphics in Canva

- Write and improve social-media captions

- Schedule and publish content across **LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and YouTube**

- Organize our video and content library

- Maintain a simple weekly content calendar

- Track views, engagement and watch performance

- Help us learn which messages and formats are working

- Look for ways AI can make our content creation faster and better



### Tools



Experience with some combination of the following is preferred:



**CapCut • OpusClip • Descript • Adobe Premiere • Canva • YouTube • LinkedIn • Instagram •
**



Experience with AI video/content tools is a big plus.



You do NOT need to know every tool. We care more about your **creativity, video instincts, reliability and willingness to learn.**



### Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



- Love video editing and storytelling

- Understand what makes someone stop scrolling

- Can recognize a powerful 30–60 second moment inside a longer video

- Have good English communication skills

- Can work independently

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Welcome feedback and enjoy improving

- Are comfortable working with Christian/faith-based content

- Want a stable, long-term working relationship rather than a short freelance project



### Hours & Compensation



Approximately **20 hours per week**



Starting compensation: **$7 USD/hour**



We are looking for someone who can grow with us. Increased responsibility and compensation may be available as the role develops.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to **3 short-form videos you personally edited**. Please tell us exactly what you did on each video.

3. Which video-editing programs and AI tools you use.

4. Your current availability and how many hours per week you can commit.

5. Your internet speed and computer specifications.

6. Your answer to this question:



**“If I gave you a 10-minute video of a business leader talking about faith, work and leadership, how would you d
 which 60 seconds should become a Reel?”**



### IMPORTANT — Please Follow This Instruction



Begin your application with the words:



**“VIDEO FIRST”**



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



### Final Step



We will select a small number of finalists and provide each person with the **same raw video**.



Finalists will be **paid to create two short-form social videos** from the raw footage.



We are not looking for the fanciest résumé.



We are looking for someone with **good judgment, creativity, initiative and the ability to tell a compelling story through video.**



If that sounds like you, we'd enjoy meeting you.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Find and verify relevant business contacts.
