s and Instagram messages that connect our products to each business’s customers and commercial needs.

• Manage follow-ups, respond to questions, handle objections, and move prospects toward their first wholesale order.

• Help interested partners choose suitable styles, shapes, and lengths using our product materials.

• Involve the founder when an opportunity requires additional support or approval.

• Keep clear records of prospects, outreach, replies, sales stages, and next steps.

• Submit a brief daily update and suggest improvements based on prospect feedback.

• Work within approved pricing and partnership terms.



AI SKILLS REQUIRED



You must actively use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools to improve prospect research, qualification, outreach, objection handling, and follow-up workflows.



You must know how to:



• Give AI clear instructions and relevant business context.

• Check research against reliable sources.

• Turn AI drafts into natural, persuasive, personalized English.

• Use AI efficiently without sacrificing accuracy or brand quality.

• Protect confidential business and customer information.



Generic AI-generated messages, invented business details, and unverified claims are not acceptable.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven outbound B2B sales experience, ideally involving physical products or wholesale partnerships.

• Experience moving prospects beyond an initial reply toward a paid order.

• Strong written English and confident communication.

• Good judgment about which businesses fit a premium beauty brand.

• Consistent follow-up habits and organized CRM or spreadsheet records.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize promising opportunities, and recommend next steps.

• Availability to overlap with US Eastern Time for prospect conversations.



Experience in beauty, fashion, bridal, or retail wholesale is a plus.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



We evaluate prospect quality, meaningful replies, qualified sales opportunities, paid first orders, and repeat orders.



Sending a large number of messages alone is not success. We value relevant outreach, consistent follow-up, and profitable customer relationships.



WORK ARRANGEMENT



• Remote, part-time.

• Approximately 15–20 hours per week.

• Hourly base pay plus sales commission, with terms agreed before starting.

• A paid two-week trial to assess research quality, communication, follow-up, and working fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A relevant outbound sales case: what you sold, who you targeted, the timeframe, how many unique prospects you contacted, and how many became paying customers. Clearly distinguish reply rate from purchase conversion and explain your personal contribution.



2. One initial outreach
 and one follow-up you have written. Remove confidential information.



3. The AI tools you use and how they fit into your sales workflow.



4. One AI-assisted outreach example showing your prompt, the AI draft, and your final edited version.



5. How you would respond to a retailer who says: “Your products look nice, but we’re not sure our customers would buy them.”



6. Your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and available working hours in US Eastern Time.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid assessment: research a potential retail partner, explain why it fits Lovevian, and create a personalized outreach

title: Screening & Sales Operations Manager
description:
**PLEASE UPLOAD A VIDEO RECORDING WITH YOUR APPLICATION**



Are you a highly driven BPO leader with a proven track record of transforming outbound callers into top-tier sales machines? We are a fast-growing door-to-door (D2D) recruiting company actively scaling our international operations. We are looking for a dynamic Screening & Sales Operations Manager to take the helm of our fully remote outbound screening team.

KPI & Data Management: Track, analyze, and report on daily/weekly team KPIs (call volume, connect rates, screening completion, etc.) to the Director of Production.

Script & Pitch Optimization: Continuously refine and A/B test pitch frameworks to maximize engagement from cold and warm leads.

Objection Handling Mastery: Train and drill screeners on advanced objection handling techniques specific to recruiting for Door-to-Door (D2D) sales opportunities.

Conversion Optimization: Bridge the gap between operations and sales by actively working to improve the conversion rate of screened candidates to actual D2D job placements.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of BPO/Call Center Management experience, with a specific focus on overseeing SDRs, appointment setters, or outbound sales teams.

Sales Acumen: Deep understanding of outbound sales psychology, lead generation, and pitch delivery. (Prior experience in recruiting or D2D sales is a massive plus).

Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage, motivate, and retain remote teams, holding them accountable to strict performance metrics while fostering a positive, growth-oriented culture.

Communication: Exceptional, near-native English fluency (both written and verbal) with the ability to clearly communicate complex sales concepts.

Technical & Workspace Requirements:

A quiet, distraction-free home office setup.

Reliable, high-speed primary internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a guaranteed backup connection.

Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or backup generator to ensure zero downtime during power outages.

To ensure you are on track for success, your performance in the first 90 days will be measured by:

Candidate Conversion Rates: Measurable increase in the percentage of leads successfully screened and converted into qualified D2D sales reps.

Call Quality & QA Scores: Elevating the team’s average QA scores through consistent auditing and active coaching.

Team Retention & Morale: Maintaining low turnover within the screening team while building a high-performance, supportive culture.

Operational Consistency: Achieving 95%+ SLA compliance for daily shift coverage and scheduled call volume.

Compensation & Perks

Highly Competitive Salary: $1,500 – $2,000 USD per month (depending on experience).

True Remote Flexibility: 100% work-from-home setup, allowing you to work from anywhere in the Philippines.

Career Trajectory: Get in on the ground floor of a rapidly scaling department, with direct access to executive leadership and clear paths for future promotion.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Overview

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Executive Personal Assistant (EA) to support the client, a senior advisor whose time is split between board/advisory duties, an active luxury watch collecting hobby, and a growing YouTube channel and website dedicated to watch reviews and commentary. The EA is the central point of coordination across the client's calendar, correspondence, travel, and the small team of freelance creatives (video editor, thumbnail/YouTube specialist) who support his content projects. This role requires discretion, strong written English, comfort working across time zones (client is frequently based in or traveling to Israel and other regions), and genuine interest in — or willingness to learn — the luxury watch space.



Calendar, Travel & Meeting Support

Manage and proactively review the client's calendar; confirm meeting details a day ahead and flag conflicts or missing information before they become last-minute issues.

Coordinate international travel (multi-city/multi-country trips, e.g. Europe) including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries built around watch events, boutique visits, and business meetings.

Track and pre-confirm meeting details directly with external parties when the client references a conversation or contact that hasn't yet been shared with the EA, to avoid mixed-up expectations.



Communications & Correspondence

Monitor and manage Outlook inbox; draft, send, and track replies, escalating anything sensitive or ambiguous before responding.

Serve as a discreet liaison between the client and stakeholders — board contacts, boutique/dealer contacts, freelance collaborators, and personal contacts — adjusting tone appropriately for each.

Make outbound calls to watch boutiques and dealers internationally (e.g. via Viber Out or similar) to inquire about specific pieces the client is looking to acquire, and track/report call costs for billing.



YouTube Channel & Content Coordination

Act as the coordination hub between the client, his  video editor, and the thumbnail/description specialist — organizing shared drive folders, routing footage and revisions, and keeping the weekly upload cadence on track.

Attend the recurring production/status call with the video editor, and relay direction, feedback, and any equipment or audio-quality issues between the client and the editor.

Maintain organized folder structures (raw footage, edited videos ready for review, final takes, thumbnails) so nothing is lost between contributors.



LinkedIn & Written Content

Manage the client's LinkedIn presence: review and lightly edit articles he drafts (removing AI-sounding phrasing/artifacts per his preference), add cover images and supporting visuals, and publish on a regular cadence.

Monitor article/post performance where possible and flag which topics and formats perform best.

Handle LinkedIn messages and comments per the client's preferences, consulting him before replying where the account or topic is sensitive.



Watch Collecting & Personal Projects

Research and reach out to boutiques and dealers worldwide regarding specific watches the client wants to acquire; track availability, pricing, and follow-ups.

Support other personal projects and errands tied to the collecting hobby (customization requests, provenance/authentication research, event bookings) as they arise.



Technology & Reporting

Provide basic tech support and setup help (primarily Outlook), and flag/troubleshoot recurring issues (e.g. recording/audio equipment settings).

Support exploration and upkeep of AI tools the client wants incorporated into his workflow (e.g. a Claude-based workspace setup), including keeping prompts and configurations updated — this complements rather than replaces the EA role.

Submit a short end-of-week report summarizing completed tasks and any open items.





Schedule & Availability

Approx. 10–15 hours per week, structured around the client's needs; hours can flex up with advance notice and are billed accordingly.

Monday–Friday coverage, with light on-call availability for time-sensitive scheduling changes or confirmations.

Because the client collaborates with teams and contacts in Israel, availability to check and action scheduling items on Sundays is required (Israel's start of work week).





Requirements

Prior experience as an Executive/Personal Assistant, ideally supporting a senior executive, advisor, or entrepreneur.

Strong written English and comfort drafting or lightly editing articles/LinkedIn posts.

Excellent organizational skills and follow-through — able to coordinate multiple freelancers and moving pieces without things falling through the cracks.

Working proficiency with Outlook (calendar and
); comfortable picking up new tools quickly, including AI-assisted workflows.

Highest level of discretion when handling personal, financial, or sensitive information.

Comfortable making international calls to boutiques/vendors on the client's behalf.





Nice to Have

Genuine interest in or knowledge of luxury watches or the luxury goods market.

Experience coordinating with video editors, designers, or other creative freelancers.

Background supporting C-suite hospital executives or investment/medical-field leadership — the client's prior career and several ongoing connections are in the hospital/medical investment space.

 and help it grow.



What your day looks like



You talk to creators. That's most of the job. You welcome new ones, answer their questions, follow up with the quiet ones, and keep everyone excited to post about us. You'll sound like a real person, not a bot or a template.



Around that, you will:



Run our creator

Look at creator stats and help pick who gets free samples

Send samples through our 3PL and track what shipped

Give creators honest feedback on their videos (we train you on what good TikTok content looks like)

Use tools like Kalodata and Euka to bring in new creators

Post a short daily update in Slack and keep our Google Sheets clean



Pay



Base pay of $4 per hour, plus a monthly bonus tied to TikTok Shop sales from the creators you manage. The better the community does, the more you make. We'll walk you through exactly how the bonus works before you start. Paid training from day one.



You're a great fit if



You have a baseline understanding of tiktok shop and tiktok algorithm

Your written English is clear and natural, and you're comfortable on calls

You've messaged lots of people in a role before (community, social media, sales, support, anything like that)

You learn fast from videos and reading

You stay organized and nothing slips through the cracks




, TikTok Shop, or Slack experience is a plus, not required.



Details



Full-time, remote

US Eastern hours, with some flexibility

You report directly to one of our co-founders



How to apply



Send a short message about a TikTok account or brand you think does a great job, and why.
salary: Base pay of $4 per hour plus milestone

title: AI Operations Lead — Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)
description:
We're a group of four companies, and we're hiring one exceptional person to run operations across all of them with AI tools. You will build and operate the systems that enable each company to run efficiently; you will not replace the functional managers or assume responsibility for their people management.

ARC Group - in-office BPO teams (10+) for mid-sized US companies. No onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

ARC Remote - managed remote staffing for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media - a WhatsApp media channel for the Orthodox Jewish community.

SetCo / 
 - business entity-formation services.

You report directly to the founder. You'll work closely with our Chief of Staff, she builds the structures, systems, and trusted ground operations; you bring AI-powered execution, optimization, and intelligence. Complementary strengths, not a hierarchy. 

CORE OPERATING PRINCIPLES

Read this carefully: this is a job for a human being who is exceptionally good at using AI tools. Not "uses ChatGPT sometimes." You take entire workflows, lead generation, performance reporting, content planning, billing, invoicing, follow-ups and rebuild them so one person with the right AI stack does what used to take a team. 

However, AI is a means, not the objective.

Impact over tools: We are not automating for automation’s sake. Every system you build must improve revenue, speed, accuracy, cost, visibility, or operational capacity.

Build before you automate: You don’t automate broken processes. First understand the business objective, map the workflow, identify failure points, simplify the process, and then automate what should be automated.

Human judgment: You know when NOT to automate. You understand where human judgment, client relationships, management decisions, and executive judgment must remain human.

AUTHORITY & ESCALATION

You are expected to independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and implement approved operational improvements. You may modify systems and workflows within your area of ownership, but significant changes affecting clients, staffing, pricing, contractual commitments, or company-wide processes require founder approval.

PRIORITIES, IN ORDER

ARC Group pipeline. This is the money. Build the machine that fills it.

ARC Remote running without the founder. Systematize it until he only shows up for relationships and closes.

Kipkeh operations. Money workflow, creator direction, performance intelligence.

NewLLC - automations & processes. Set up the automations and processes alongside the Chief of Staff, so we can hire an admin who handles client relations, billing, filing, and account management and upsells clients into ARC Remote and Kipkeh.

THE MANDATE

Process & SOP Automation - Automate, and continuously improve operational workflows within your assigned areas if necessary. Coordinate with the Chief of Staff and functional owners before materially changing established business processes.

Data & AI Responsibility - You will work with sensitive business, client, employee, and candidate information. You must use approved tools, follow company data-handling rules, and never upload confidential information into an AI platform without authorization.

Marketing - our highest-leverage early win (see below).

Sales support - pipeline tracking, follow-up systems, proposal/invoice workflows. (Closing stays with the founder.)

Recruitment - help hire the roles behind you: screening support, structured interview workflows, candidate tracking.

Management oversight (systems, not people) - build the intelligence layer our managers run on: dashboards, underperformance alerts, KPI tracking, staffing-ratio models. You make problems visible early with data. You do NOT have performance conversations or manage anyone's motivation - when your systems flag a problem, you bring the data to the manager or founder, and they handle the human side.

Systems - design workflows that don't break: edge cases handled, handoffs clean, documented.

Data & reporting - turn raw, messy operational data into decisions. Daily numbers, weekly what's-working analysis, forecasts.

Content operations & direction - direct our on-camera creator with data-backed briefs: what to film, when, and why.

Billing, invoicing, payment tracking - build the money workflow from zero and run it.

Keep up & be ahead - your AI stack is never stale. You bring us tools and methods before we know we need them.

YOUR FIRST BIG WIN: BUILD OUR MARKETING ENGINE

Our Chief of Staff currently runs a small
 lead-gen motion for ARC Group - personally sending 50–100
s, no sequences, no A/B testing. It's time-consuming and going nowhere. The stack is already paid for: Google Workspace + Instantly + Apollo + NeverBounce.

Your job: turn it into a real pipeline machine. Target: 500+
s/week with proper sequences, A/B testing, AI-assisted personalization, tracked follow-ups, and a dashboard the founder can read in 60 seconds. You'll also run the support system behind the founder's LinkedIn outreach, which activates alongside this plan.

 outreach, list building, sequencing, follow-up tracking - or a credible plan to build it fast.

 engine live - 500+/week sending on Instantly with sequences and A/B tests. Baseline bounce and unsubscribe rates are actively tracked. First sprint launched on the ICP; LinkedIn support running. ARC Remote audit done: every founder-touch workflow mapped, first one pulled off his plate. The money workflow started. Trial decision point: performing at band level, or we part ways.

 engine at full volume - 500+/week sending, 2+ A/B tests run with learnings logged. title: Senior Accountant
description:

ABOUT BOOSTED COMMERCE



Boosted Commerce (founded in 2019) is a digitally-native, CPG platform focused on acquiring and building new, fast-growing beauty, health, and wellness brands. We are a seasoned team of traditional retail and ecommerce operators already scaling several consumer brands with proven product-market fit.



As we expand our operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior Accountant to join our accounting team and help us build robust, scalable accounting practices that support our continued growth.



Position Summary



The Senior Accountant will play a key role in managing weekly and month-end accounting operations related to sales audit, payment reconciliation, cash applications, multi-currency transactions, inventory management, and sales tax. This position requires strong experience working with eCommerce platforms and high transaction volumes, along with excellent problem-solving, process improvement, analytical, and organizational skills.



You will work closely with the Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to ensure financial accuracy, timely reporting, and operational efficiency.

Perform and support the monthly close process for Revenue, Cash, AR, Inventory & COGS, and Prepaid accounts.

Prepare and maintain supporting documentation, reconciliations, and internal controls to ensure accuracy and support audit and compliance requirements.

Audit and reconcile sales transactions across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other eCommerce platforms. Investigate and resolve variances, missing transactions, and sales invoices.

Reconcile cash receipts and AR balances across multiple payment platforms, including Amazon, Shopify, Payoneer, PayPal, Stripe, and other payment providers, as well as the accounting ERP system.

Investigate and resolve GL discrepancies and reconciling items in a timely manner.

Support inventory accounting and reconciliations, including inventory adjustments, inventory in transit, and prepaid inventory.

Partner with the Supply Chain team to investigate and resolve inventory and COGS variances.

Prepare and support monthly reporting and analysis related to Amazon operating expenses, Shopify sales tax, and other financial activities.

Support various ad hoc accounting and financial analysis projects as needed.

Identify opportunities to improve and streamline billing, reconciliation, reporting, and accounting processes.

Recommend and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

5+ years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an eCommerce, DTC, consumer goods, or high-volume transaction environment.

Strong understanding of GAAP and the month-end close process.

Demonstrated experience preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial analyses, including resolving complex reconciling items.

CPA or CPA candidate preferred.

Strong hands-on experience reconciling multi-channel sales and payment gateways and analyzing detailed transaction reports from platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and TikTok Shop.

Strong experience with ERP systems, with NetSuite highly preferred.

Experience supporting or participating in accounting system implementations, process improvements, or other operational projects.

Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.

Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

title: Property Photography QC & Delivery Coordinator / Virtual Assistant
description:
We’re a UK property photography business looking for a reliable, detail-focused assistant to manage media quality checks, delivery, bookings and client communication.



The most important part of this role is taking responsibility for each job through to completion. You should notice missing images, follow up with our editor, resolve small issues and get the finished job delivered without needing to be chased at every step.



Confident phone communication and excellent clutter/object-removal skills are essential. This is primarily a coordination, quality-control and VA role, with clutter removal and occasional quick revisions. Our editor handles the main photo editing.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CALLING HOMEOWNERS AND SCHEDULING



• Call UK homeowners to arrange photography appointments through Spiro, our booking and delivery portal.

• Speak confidently, clearly and in a friendly, professional manner.

• Confirm property addresses, availability, access arrangements and special instructions.

• Handle scheduling and rescheduling through Spiro and keep booking notes accurate.



2. QUALITY CHECKS, CLUTTER REMOVAL AND DELIVERY



• Check incoming media each morning around 10am UK time and prepare jobs for delivery.

• Use your own judgement to spot distracting clutter and remove it to a high standard. Strong object-removal skills are a major part of this role.

• Check removals closely for visible editing marks, repeated textures, distorted objects and other errors.

• Inspect every image for straight verticals, level horizons, correct perspective, consistent colour and exposure, sharpness and clean editing.

• Check for distracting reflections, visible equipment, unnatural retouching and AI-generated errors.

• Make sure every job includes the expected rooms and ordered media, with no missing files, duplicates or incorrect property details.

• Check floor plans for the correct address, clear labels and obvious issues such as missing doors or inconsistent layouts, using the available photographs and job information.

• Upload, organise and deliver media through Spiro. Experience is helpful, but training can be provided.

• Check delivery links and ensure the final presentation is complete and professional.



3. MANAGING REVISION REQUESTS



• Respond to estate agents’ revision requests through
 and WhatsApp.

• Understand what needs changing, ask clear questions where necessary and take ownership of getting it resolved.

• Complete occasional small or urgent photo revisions yourself to a high standard.

• Send clear instructions to our editor for larger revisions, follow up and check the finished work.

• Replace the correct files and let the client know when the changes are ready.



4.
 AND DAY-TO-DAY ADMINISTRATION



• Monitor
s, respond to routine enquiries and keep outstanding requests moving.

• Maintain accurate booking notes and job statuses.

• Flag urgent issues or anything requiring my decision.

• Provide a short daily handover covering completed jobs, outstanding revisions and upcoming bookings.

• Help with other small administrative tasks related to the business.



5. OCCASIONAL TWILIGHT EDITS



• Create twilight edits using my Higgsfield account when requested, following our examples and quality standards.



REQUIREMENTS



• Confident, clear and easily understood spoken English, alongside strong written English. You must be comfortable calling UK homeowners and communicating professionally with estate agents.

• Excellent clutter and object-removal skills. This is particularly important: please provide before-and-after examples demonstrating clean, convincing results.

• Proven photo-retouching ability, ideally with property photography experience.

• The ability to complete occasional quick photo revisions to a high standard.

• Excellent attention to detail and the judgement to spot clutter, quality issues and missing information independently.

• Strong organisation and follow-through. You take ownership of tasks and keep people updated.

• Reliable availability around 10am UK time, with agreed working hours for calls, messages and revisions.

• A reliable internet connection, suitable computer and a quiet environment for phone calls.

• Willingness to learn Spiro and follow our workflow.



WORKING HOURS AND OPPORTUNITY TO GROW



This is a part-time position, initially around 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with work starting around 10am UK time. The exact schedule will be agreed with the successful applicant.



We currently handle approximately three property jobs per day and have ambitious plans to grow over the coming months. We’re looking for someone who would like to grow with the business, with the potential for increased hours and responsibilities as bookings increase.



Additional hours will be agreed together. There is potential for this to become a full-time role in the future, although this is not guaranteed.





HOW TO APPLY

title: Google Ads Support Specialist
description:
# Google Ads Support Specialist



**Remote | Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising**



## About Slaymaker Marketing



Slaymaker Marketing is a growing digital advertising agency managing paid-media campaigns for e-commerce and B2B clients. We combine senior-level strategy with hands-on execution across Google, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other advertising platforms.



We value honesty, improvement, respect, ownership, selflessness, and results. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, pays close attention to detail, and takes responsibility for producing accurate work.



## About the Role



We are hiring a Google Ads Support Specialist to support campaign implementation, optimization, QA, analysis, and reporting across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.



You will work alongside experienced account leads who own client strategy and communication. Your role will be to translate that strategy into accurate campaign execution, monitor account performance, maintain organized documentation, and proactively surface opportunities and concerns.



This role is ideal for someone with strong Google Ads fundamentals who wants to develop into an independent account manager and strategist.



## What You’ll Own Day to Day



* Build and update Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, and YouTube campaigns

* Conduct keyword, search-term, competitor, audience, and placement research

* Develop and implement keyword lists, match types, negatives, audiences, and targeting

* Draft and upload responsive search ads, extensions, assets, and other ad variations

* Make approved changes to bids, budgets, targeting, exclusions, and campaign settings

* Monitor spend pacing, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, impression share, and other relevant metrics

* Review search terms and identify negative keywords or expansion opportunities

* Conduct routine account checks and flag unusual performance or delivery changes

* Pull and organize data for client reporting and internal analysis

* Prepare performance notes, insights, and recommended actions before client calls

* Support Google Merchant Center and product-feed troubleshooting

* Maintain campaign naming conventions, labels, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Review conversion actions, attribution settings, URLs, and campaign goals

* Document completed changes, test results, open questions, and next steps

* Implement campaigns and changes in Microsoft Advertising when needed

* Proactively identify opportunities instead of waiting exclusively for assigned tasks



## QA Expectations



Every campaign build or major change must receive complete QA. You will be expected to verify:



* Campaign type, objective, bidding strategy, budget, and schedule

* Keywords, match types, negatives, audiences, and exclusions

* Geographic, demographic, device, network, and language settings

* Ad copy, assets, final URLs, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Conversion actions and campaign-level conversion goals

* Merchant Center products, feed settings, and product-group structures

* Brand exclusions, account-level negatives, and suitability settings

* Naming conventions and reporting consistency

* Alignment with the approved strategy and client instructions



## Required Qualifications



* Hands-on experience building and optimizing Google Ads campaigns

* Strong understanding of Search campaign structures and keyword strategy

* Familiarity with Shopping and Performance Max campaigns

* Ability to interpret performance data and identify meaningful trends

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to pre-launch QA

* Clear written English and dependable internal communication

* Strong organization and time-management skills

* Ability to manage work across multiple accounts and deadlines

* Willingness to document work and communicate progress proactively

* Ability to identify concerns and suggest solutions before escalating them



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting both e-commerce and B2B lead-generation accounts

* Familiarity with Microsoft Advertising and Google Merchant Center

* Experience with GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, Shopify, and HubSpot

* Understanding of conversion tracking and offline conversion imports

* Experience with product feeds and feed-optimization tools

* Familiarity with value-based bidding, attribution, and lifecycle-stage reporting

* Experience working with monthly advertising budgets of $50,000 or more

* Familiarity with project-management and team-communication platforms



## What Success Looks Like



* Campaigns and optimizations are completed accurately and on schedule

* Every launch receives thorough QA

* Search-term reviews and account checks are completed consistently

* Reporting data and call-preparation notes are accurate and useful

* Performance issues are identified and escalated early

* Account leads have clear visibility into completed work and blockers

* Recommendations are supported by data and aligned with client goals

* You gradually progress from execution support toward independent ownership of smaller accounts



## What We’re Looking For



The right person is analytical, dependable, organized, and proactive. You should be comfortable following a defined strategy while also thinking critically about whether the requested implementation makes sense.



We do not want someone who blindly completes tasks. We want someone who checks their work, raises concerns, investigates performance changes, and contributes ideas for improvement.



To apply, please provide:



* A brief overview of your Google Ads experience

* The campaign types and monthly budgets you have managed or supported

* Examples of e-commerce or lead-generation accounts you have worked on

* An example of an optimization or QA issue you identified

* Your experience with GA4, GTM, Merchant Center, and Microsoft Advertising

* Your availability and preferred working hours

title: 3PL Operations Coordinator (Shopify + 3PL Experience Required)
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is NOT a general virtual assistant or customer service role. We will only consider applicants who have directly worked with a 3PL (third-party logistics / fulfillment warehouse) AND have hands-on Shopify experience. If you do not have both, please do not apply.



ABOUT US

Easy Clothes is a fast-growing, French-designed women's fashion brand selling direct to consumers in the US on Shopify Plus. We launch around 30 new styles every two weeks across thousands of SKUs. We are moving our fulfillment to ShipBob, and we need an experienced person to own the 3PL side of our business during the transition and long term.



SCHEDULE

Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Los Angeles time

(11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time; 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM PH time from November to March due to US daylight saving)



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



1. Manage inbound inventory with our logistics companies

- Work daily with our freight forwarders and logistics partners (including shipments from overseas) to make sure inventory is sent to the 3PL correctly

- Make sure every shipment matches the 3PL's requirements: packaging, box labeling, barcodes, carton contents, and paperwork

- Create and manage Warehouse Receiving Orders (WROs / ASNs) with accurate SKUs, quantities, and box details

- Guide and train our logistics partners so they do things right during the transition and going forward

- Resolve receiving problems fast (unidentified boxes, quantity mismatches, missing WROs) before they turn into delays and fees



2. Audit and push the 3PL

- Consistently double-check what the 3PL is doing and flag where we need to push to keep things on track

- Monitor orders daily to confirm they ship on time according to our contract (SLA) with the 3PL

- Track receiving times, order accuracy, and exceptions, and escalate to the 3PL account team when they miss



3. Protect our money

- Review every 3PL and carrier invoice against what we actually used (storage, receiving, picks, packaging, shipping, returns)

- Catch overcharges and billing errors, dispute them, and follow through until credited



4. Keep inventory accurate

- Reconcile inventory counts between the 3PL and Shopify

- Investigate discrepancies, damaged or lost units, and file claims when needed



5. Escalate and communicate

- Be the liaison between the 3PL, our logistics companies, and our in-house team

- Escalate issues to the right person: Inventory Manager, Customer Service, Marketing Manager, and management

- Send a clear weekly report: on-time shipping rate, receiving status, inventory accuracy, billing issues found, and open problems



MUST HAVE (required)

- Direct experience working with a 3PL or fulfillment center on the brand side or the warehouse side

- Hands-on Shopify experience with orders, products, and inventory

- Experience creating inbound shipments / WROs / ASNs and coordinating with freight or logistics companies

- Experience auditing 3PL or carrier invoices

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciling two data sets)

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Very detail-oriented. A wrong quantity or SKU costs real money

- Confident enough to push vendors and follow up until things are fixed

- Reliable internet with backup power or internet, and a quiet workspace



NICE TO HAVE

- ShipBob experience (big plus)

- Fashion or apparel experience (sizes, colors, high SKU counts)

- Experience with a warehouse move or 3PL transition

- Knowledge of US carriers and LTL freight



START DATE

As soon as possible.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "3PL Ready". Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Then answer these 5 questions in your own words (no AI-written answers, we can tell):

1. Have you worked with ShipBob before? Answer clearly YES or NO. (ShipBob experience is not required, we just need to know.) If yes, for which brand and for how long?

2. Which other 3PL(s) have you worked with, for which brand, and for how long?

3. What did you do in Shopify day to day?

4. Describe a time you caught a 3PL or carrier billing error. What was it and how did you fix it?

5. What is a WRO or ASN, and what are the most common mistakes that cause receiving delays?



Also include:

- Your resume

- A 1 to 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

title: Operations & Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
Operations & Administrative Virtual Assistant

Painting Business + Timmy T’s Gourmet Grinders Franchise Operations

We are hiring an organized, proactive virtual assistant to support CJ across his painting business and Timmy T’s franchised restaurant operations.

Your job is to make both businesses run more smoothly: organize information, create clear procedures, coordinate recurring tasks, support payroll and bookkeeping, and follow through until work is complete.

What you must be excellent at

SOP creation: Turn verbal instructions, recordings, and existing processes into clear procedures with steps, screenshots, checklists, and examples.

Communication: Write clearly, acknowledge requests, ask useful questions, and communicate problems before deadlines are missed.

Organization: Keep tasks, calendars, documents, records, and deadlines accurate and easy to find.

Operational improvement: Identify missing steps, repeated problems, and unnecessary work, then recommend practical improvements.

Follow-through: Track each task through completion and verify the result.

Core responsibilities across both businesses

Maintain a central task list with an owner, priority, deadline, and status.

Manage recurring daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly administrative checklists.

Create and maintain SOPs that another person can follow successfully.

Coordinate with CJ, managers, employees, customers, and vendors.

Follow up on missing information and unfinished work.

Keep each business’s records, accounts, and financial information separate.

Provide a concise weekly update covering completed work, open issues, upcoming deadlines, and decisions needed from CJ.

Payroll and QuickBooks

Gather and review time records before payroll deadlines.

Flag missing punches, unusual hours, and discrepancies for review.

Prepare payroll for CJ’s approval and process approved payroll.

Verify payroll results and maintain supporting records.

Enter and organize bills, receipts, invoices, and payments in QuickBooks.

Support account reconciliation and coordinate questions with the bookkeeper or accountant.

Track customer balances, vendor bills, and upcoming payment deadlines.

Flag unclear transactions instead of guessing.

Changes to employee pay, bank details, or payment instructions require CJ’s approval.

Painting business support

Organize customer inquiries and estimate requests.

Track estimates, follow-ups, approvals, and job schedules.

Coordinate job information among CJ, customers, and crews.

Maintain job folders with scope, approvals, changes, photos, and billing records.

Prepare invoices from approved job information and follow up on outstanding balances.

Document the workflow from initial inquiry through completed job and payment.

Timmy T’s franchise support

Help store managers stay on top of paperwork, hiring, and administrative deadlines.

Track completion of assigned operational checklists and follow up on missing items.

Organize invoices, inventory records, deposit documentation, and payroll information.

Support job postings, applicant organization, interview scheduling, and onboarding paperwork.

Draft customer review and feedback responses using approved brand guidelines.

Maintain organized access to current brand SOPs and resources.

Identify recurring administrative problems and help implement consistent solutions.

How we work

Acknowledge requests during agreed working hours.

Confirm the expected result and deadline.

Ask before proceeding when instructions are unclear.

Notify CJ early if something will be late or needs a different approach.

Review work for accuracy before submitting it.

Report time honestly and work with a sense of urgency.

Protect confidential information and use only approved accounts and tools.

Document important processes so the business does not depend on one person’s memory.

Our follow-through standard is:

ISSUE → OWNER → DEADLINE → CHECK-BACK → COMPLETE → VERIFIED

Required experience

Hands-on QuickBooks experience.

Experience preparing and processing payroll accurately.

Strong written and spoken English.

Demonstrated experience writing SOPs and managing recurring work.

Ability to support multiple businesses without mixing records or priorities.

Reliable internet and availability during agreed hours that overlap with Hawaiʻi business hours.

Restaurant, construction, painting, or other service-business experience is a plus.

First 30 days

Learn both businesses, their tools, and their recurring deadlines.

Build a central task list and administrative calendar.

Organize existing documents and identify missing procedures.

Document the payroll and bookkeeping workflows.

Create and test the highest-priority SOPs.

Establish a consistent weekly reporting and follow-up routine.

How to Apply

We value preparation, attention to detail, and clear communication. Generic applications that do not follow these instructions will not move forward.

Use this subject line:

Operations VA – [Your Name] – Painting + Timmy T’s

Please include your résumé and answer the following questions using numbered responses:

Research Timmy T’s Gourmet Grinders. In 3–5 sentences, explain what you learned about the business and how this role would support its store managers. Include a link to the source you used.

Show relevant experience. Describe your actual responsibilities using QuickBooks and payroll software. Name the systems you used and explain what you handled personally.

Provide an SOP sample. Share one you created, with confidential information removed. Explain the problem it solved and how you confirmed someone else could follow it. If you cannot share previous work, provide a short original sample and label it as such.

Explain your follow-through. Payroll is due tomorrow. A painting foreman has not submitted crew hours, and a restaurant manager has unresolved employee punches. What would you do, in what order, and what would you communicate to CJ?

Give a real example. Tell us about a time you had to follow up repeatedly with a manager or supervisor to get something completed. What did you do, and what was the outcome?

Confirm availability and rate. Include your working hours in Hawaiʻi time, expected hourly or monthly rate, earliest start date, and other work commitments.

End your application with this sentence, completing the blank in your own words:

“To me, a task is verified complete when ______.”

Keep your responses specific and concise. We do not need a lengthy cover letter. Writing tools are acceptable, but your examples and experience must be your own, and you must be able to explain everything you submit during an interview.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and a paid practical assessment.

 would organize recurring work across two businesses.

title: OMS Medical & Dental Billing Specialist — 2+ Years OMS Required
description:
Remote — Philippines | Part-time | $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience



REQUIRED: 2+ years of hands-on billing for U.S. oral & maxillofacial surgery (OMS) practices, including personally handling BOTH medical and dental insurance claims. Please apply only if you meet all of these requirements.



We’re looking for an experienced OMS billing specialist who can independently manage medical and dental claims. General medical billing, general dental billing, or experience in other surgical specialties alone does not meet this requirement. Eligibility verification or payment posting alone does not qualify.



We need someone who understands the full lifecycle of a medical claim and can independently work through difficult claims from submission to payment.



The role will start at 8 hours/week, with the opportunity to increase hours over time as we add practices.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Verify medical and dental insurance eligibility and benefits.

• Determine whether procedures can appropriately be billed to medical insurance.

• Review clinical notes and supporting documentation for medical necessity.

• Identify appropriate ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and CDT codes.

• Cross-code dental procedures to medical when appropriate.

• Prepare and submit medical and dental claims.

• Obtain prior authorizations when required.

• Attach clinical documentation, narratives, imaging, and other supporting material.

• Track claims through adjudication.

• Investigate rejected and denied claims; submit corrected claims and appeals.

• Interpret EOBs and ERAs; post payments and adjustments.

• Follow up on outstanding insurance A/R and call U.S. insurance companies when needed.

• Coordinate medical and dental insurance when both are involved.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• At least 2 years of hands-on billing for U.S. OMS practices.

• Direct experience personally preparing, submitting, and following BOTH medical and dental OMS claims through adjudication, payment, and denial resolution.

• Experience personally working claims from eligibility through payment.

• Working knowledge of ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, and CDT, including dental-to-medical cross-coding when appropriate.

• Experience coordinating medical and dental benefits for OMS services.

• Experience with denials, appeals, insurance A/R, and clinical documentation supporting claims.

• Experience working directly with U.S. commercial insurance companies.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

• Based in the Philippines, with a reliable setup for remote work.



Payment posting alone does not count as full-cycle billing experience.



STRONGLY PREFERRED



• Medical billing for oral surgery procedures such as wisdom teeth, anesthesia, pathology, trauma, TMJ, sleep apnea, or implants, where coverage and medical necessity support billing.

• Open Dental, WinOMS, OMSVision, Dentrix, or similar practice-management software.



OMS experience and both medical and dental billing experience are mandatory, not preferred. This position requires someone who can bring that experience from the start.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a U.S.-based startup building a new billing service for oral surgery practices.



Initially, this role will be very hands-on: reviewing cases, submitting claims, following them through payment, and solving problems when claims are denied.



You’ll also work directly with the founder to document how the work is done and improve the systems and tools used to perform it. We’re looking for someone who can bring real medical billing expertise and work independently.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



• $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience.

• 8 hours/week initially, with the opportunity to increase hours over time as we add practices.

• Remote, Philippines-based.

• Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. business hours for payer calls.

• Opportunity for significantly more hours and responsibility over time.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions. Specific answers are much more valuable than a long cover letter. Please use only anonymized examples and do not include patient-identifying information.



1. How many years have you personally billed for U.S. OMS practices? Give the month/year dates for each OMS billing role and describe your responsibilities. Please apply only if you have at least 2 years.

2. In those OMS roles, which medical AND dental claims did you personally prepare, submit, and follow through payment or denial resolution? Name the procedures, insurers, and billing systems you worked with.

3. Describe one actual, anonymized OMS case you personally handled involving both medical and dental insurance. What did you submit to each payer, what documentation was required, and what was the outcome?

4. Which coding systems have you personally worked with—ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and CDT? Explain your level of experience with each.

5. Tell us about a difficult denied medical claim that you successfully got paid. What was wrong with the claim, and what did you do?

6. Describe an actual out-of-network OMS medical claim you personally handled, if you have that experience. What procedure and insurer were involved, what documentation did you submit, and what amounts were allowed, paid by insurance, and left as patient responsibility? Approximate amounts are fine. If you have not handled OON OMS medical claims, please say so.

7. Which billing or practice-management systems have you used?

8. What hourly rate are you looking for, how many hours per week are you currently available, and what overlap can you offer with U.S. business hours?



We will discuss your answers during the interview, so please answer based on your own experience.

title: FULL-TIME CSR / APPOINTMENT SETTER — HOME SERVICE LEADS (GOHIGHLEVEL REQUIRED)
description:
READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

This role requires previous experience calling leads for home service businesses (waterproofing, foundation repair, crawl space, concrete, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, pest control, solar, and similar). This is the minimum requirement, not a preference. If you do not have it, do not apply. Your application will not be reviewed.



ABOUT DRYSCALE

DryScale runs lead generation for waterproofing, crawl space, foundation repair, and concrete contractors across the United States. We get some of the best results in the space and are one of the fastest-growing agencies on the market. Our ads bring in homeowners with a real problem at the house (water in the basement, a cracking foundation, a sinking driveway) who have asked to be contacted. You are the person who calls them.



Because we're growing this fast, we need a high-quality, long-term partner in this CSR role, not a short-term hire. If you're looking for a few months of work, this isn't it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Dial every new B2C lead that comes in across our client accounts, fast. Speed-to-lead is the job.

- Book the homeowner for a free in-home inspection and estimate on the client's calendar in GoHighLevel.

- Work the follow-up: no-answers, callbacks, texts, and older leads that never booked.

- Confirm upcoming appointments so they actually hold.

- Keep GHL clean: correct pipeline stage, notes on every conversation, tags, and call outcomes.

- Handle multiple client accounts, each with its own services, service area, and calendar.

- Flag out-of-area requests, wrong-service leads, and anything the client's office needs to know.



REQUIREMENTS (ALL FIVE ARE REQUIRED)

1. Experience calling for home service businesses. Minimum requirement, see above.

2. Familiar with GoHighLevel (GHL): contacts, conversations, pipelines, and calendars.

3. At least 3 years of experience in previous roles (phone-based customer service, appointment setting, or inside sales).

4. Very fluent in English. You will be on the phone with US homeowners all day: clear, confident, and easy to understand.

5. Able to work a full-time position on US Eastern Time hours.



You'll also need reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset.



COMPENSATION

$1,500–$2,000 USD per month on-target earnings: base pay plus performance pay tied to the appointments you book.



HOW TO APPLY: SEND A 1-MINUTE VIDEO

There are no interviews at this stage. To apply, record a quick video (about 1 minute) of yourself reading the call script below, then send it to us.



Your video must:

- Show your face on camera.

- Start with your name and the home service industries you've called for, then go straight into the script.

- Be recorded with the headset or mic you'd actually use on calls, in the space you'd actually work from. We want to hear what homeowners would hear.

- Sound like a real call. Don't just read the words. Say it the way you would to a homeowner on the phone.



Read only your own lines. You don't need to act out the homeowner.



EXAMPLE SCRIPT: FOUNDATION REPAIR NEW LEAD CALL



"Hi, is this Mark? Hey Mark, this is [your name] with Summit Foundation Repair. You filled out a form on our site a few minutes ago about some cracks in your foundation. Did I catch you at an okay time?



Great. Just so I understand what's going on: are the cracks inside the basement, on the outside walls, or both? And have you noticed any doors sticking, or windows that don't close like they used to?



Okay, that's really helpful. That's exactly what our inspectors want to look at before it gets any worse. What we'll do is send a specialist out to the house for a free inspection. They'll show you what's causing it and give you a written estimate right there, no cost and no obligation.



I've got Thursday at 10 AM or Friday at 2 PM open in your area. Which one works better for you?



Perfect, you're all set for Thursday at 10. You'll get a text confirmation in the next few minutes. Thanks, Mark. Talk soon."



HOW TO SEND IT

Reply to this post with all four of the following:

1. A link to your video (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive set to "Anyone with the link can view").

2. Confirmation that you meet the minimum requirements, including which home service businesses you've called for.

3. Confirmation that you can work full-time on US Eastern Time hours.

4. Confirmation that you're familiar with GoHighLevel.



If anything is missing, or the video link doesn't open, your application will not be reviewed. Consider this the first test of the job: following instructions exactly is what this role is.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We'll watch every video and reach out directly to the applicants we think are the best fit. If you don't hear from us, you were not selected this round.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Freight Broker Sales Representative - Customer Acquisition
description:
# Freight Brokerage Sales Representative – Customer Acquisition



**GuardRail Logistics LLC** is looking for a motivated and confident **Sales Representative** to help us acquire new customers for our U.S.-based freight brokerage.



This position is **100% focused on sales and customer acquisition.**



You will NOT be responsible for dispatching trucks, finding carriers, tracking loads, negotiating with drivers, billing customers, or managing freight after the account is handed over.



**Your job is simple: Find shippers, start conversations, build relationships, generate opportunities, and bring new customers to GuardRail Logistics. We take care of the rest.**



## What You’ll Do



* Research companies that regularly ship freight

* Identify transportation managers, logistics managers, shipping managers, owners, and other decision-makers

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers

* Send personalized
s and follow-ups

* Build relationships with potential customers

* Ask questions to understand their shipping needs and problem lanes

* Follow up consistently with interested prospects

* Get GuardRail an opportunity to quote freight

* Help turn prospects into active customers

* Keep accurate notes on calls,
s, contacts, and follow-ups

* Once a customer is ready to work with us, hand the account/opportunity to the GuardRail team



## What You Will NOT Have to Do



You will **not** have to:



* Book trucks

* Dispatch drivers

* Search for carriers

* Track shipments

* Handle carrier problems

* Manage paperwork

* Invoice customers

* Handle collections

* Work loads after they have been handed over



Our team handles operations.



**You focus on SALES.**



## Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Speaks clear, professional English

* Is comfortable talking to U.S. businesses over the phone

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically capable Product Manager to help coordinate day-to-day product development between our internal team and our outsourced development partner. Experience with project management tools such as:

- 

- Jira

- ClickUp

- Linear

Strong written English communication

Ability to write clear specs, bug reports, user stories, and status updates

Comfortable working with developers across time zones

Self-starter who can work independently with minimal supervision

Must be available to work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time



Preferred Experience

Experience with SaaS or subscription-based platforms

Experience in dental, orthodontic, healthcare, or health-tech software

Experience writing agile/scrum user stories

Basic understanding of web technologies such as APIs, databases, front-end, and back-end concepts

Experience with Figma or other design tools for reviewing or annotating mockups



To Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

- Product coordination or project management

- QA testing

- Working with developers

- Project management tools you have used

3. An example of a bug report, user story, or project/task documentation you have written, if available



Subject Line: Product Manager – [Your Full Name]



We are looking for someone organized, technical, and detail-oriented who can help keep product development moving smoothly from idea to release.

title: Estimator / Construction Take-Off Specialist – Remote
description:
Remote | Australian Construction & Professional Services | Part-Time initially with opportunity to grow



About the role



We are looking for an experienced and detail-focused Estimator / Construction Take-Off Specialist to join a group of four connected Australian businesses operating across construction, manufacturing, civil works and professional services.

This is a remote role suited to someone who is confident reading Australian construction drawings and specifications, preparing accurate quantity take-offs and estimates, and checking their own work carefully.

You will work directly with our Australian teams across a varied range of projects. The type and volume of work will vary between businesses, so we are looking for someone who is adaptable, organised and comfortable working across different types of construction documentation.



What you will be doing



Your work will include:

- Reading and interpreting architectural, engineering and civil construction drawings, specifications and schedules.

- Preparing accurate quantity take-offs and estimates from construction drawings.

- Preparing window and door schedules and quotations from architectural plans.

- Assisting with light-gauge steel frame and truss detailing, material take-offs, production files and cutting lists.

- Preparing civil construction quantity take-offs, including earthworks and drainage quantities.

- Assisting with subcontractor package pricing and estimating.

- Preparing cost estimates to support Development Application (DA) and Subdivision Works Certificate applications for TA Project Services.

- Checking completed work back against the source drawings and information before submission.

- Identifying missing, inconsistent or unclear information and raising questions rather than making assumptions.

- Working with our existing systems and emerging AI-assisted checking tools.



What we are looking for



You will need:

- Demonstrated experience preparing estimates or quantity take-offs from construction drawings.

- Strong ability to read and interpret plans, elevations, sections, schedules and specifications.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy with numbers.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Confidence communicating directly with Australian team members.

- Ability to manage your workload and work reliably with limited supervision in a remote environment.

- A willingness to ask questions when information is incomplete or does not make sense.

- A reliable computer and internet connection suitable for remote work.



Experience that would be highly regarded



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

- Australian construction estimating or quantity take-offs.

- Civil construction estimating.

- Light-gauge steel frame and truss detailing.

- FrameCAD, Multinail or similar software.

- Window and door estimating or fabrication software such as AWS V6 or vQuote.

- AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam or similar software.

- Familiarity with Australian construction documentation and standards, including the NCC.

- Preparing estimates or cost information associated with Australian development or subdivision applications.



You do not need experience in every area listed above. We have technical knowledge within each business and can provide training in our specific systems and processes.



What is important is that you can read drawings accurately, work carefully with quantities and numbers, check your own work, and communicate clearly when something does not add up.



Working arrangement



This is a remote contractor position.



We expect the role to commence at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase towards full-time hours as the workload develops.



You will need to have regular working-hour overlap with the Australian Eastern Time business day to allow communication with our teams.



The initial engagement will be for three months, with the intention of continuing and expanding the role where the arrangement is working well for both parties.



Training, written procedures and support will be provided. We are also developing AI-assisted tools to improve checking and efficiency, so we are particularly interested in someone who is comfortable learning and working with new technology.



How to apply

Please provide:

- Your CV/resume.

- A short summary of your estimating and quantity take-off experience.

- Details of the types of construction drawings and projects you have worked with.

- The software you are experienced in using.

- Your current availability and preferred working hours.

- Your expected hourly rate.

- A brief example of a time when you identified an error, discrepancy or missing information in a drawing, estimate or take-off before it caused a larger problem.



Please use “Estimator – [Your Name]” as the subject of your application.

title: Legal Intake Specialist (Sales)
description:
ABOUT US

All 50 Law is a US-based, rapidly expanding personal injury law firm dedicated to helping individuals who have recently suffered an injury secure the legal support they need. We are quickly growing to become one of the largest marketing and referral-based law firms in the country. Behind our fast-paced, highly automated marketing machine is a powerhouse team: our founder is a Harvard Law School graduate, and our technical infrastructure is driven by a specialized team of product engineers holding Master’s degrees and PhDs in Computer Science.



THE ROLE

This is not a traditional administrative legal role; it is a high-performance sales position designed for a natural closer. We are seeking an individual who is assertive and competitive, yet highly people-oriented and relationship-focused. You must operate with a strong sense of urgency and adaptability, requiring a candidate who possesses balanced independence and procedural discipline. In this role, the specialist sells via phone or digital channels. You will be someone who expertly manages a pipeline and drives revenue without face-to-face interaction. Your primary objective is to build rapid trust, skillfully overcome hesitations, and guide prospects to retain our partner law firms.



A DAY IN THE LIFE

When you log in to your dedicated workspace, you will immediately dive into our custom GoHighLevel CRM. Your day will be heavily phone-based and fast-paced. You will constantly monitor incoming pipelines and jump on fresh, warm leads the moment our marketing engine generates them.



You will spend your hours speaking directly with individuals who have recently experienced an injury, requiring you to balance empathy with strong conversational control. You will ask targeted qualifying questions, navigate objections, and firmly guide eligible prospects toward signing a representation agreement. Between calls, you will aggressively manage your sales pipeline, send follow-up text messages,
s, and update client records with meticulous accuracy. You are the vital first point of contact, operating at a high frequency to turn inbound inquiries into closed deals.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

*Jump on Fresh Leads: Act with speed to engage immediately with individuals who have suffered injuries. Because these are warm leads expecting your call, your "speed to lead" is critical in capturing their interest while they are actively exploring their legal options.



*Qualify & Convert: Actively listen and assess each caller's case eligibility based on strict, provided criteria. You will ask targeted questions to uncover key details, seamlessly transitioning from qualification to the close.



*Control the Conversation: Use persuasive, confident communication to "sell" the advantages of working with our legal network. You must expertly navigate objections, instill trust, and motivate prospective clients to take the next step of signing their agreements.



*Manage Multiple Channels: Juggle prospect communication across phone calls, SMS text messages,
s, and social media direct messages to ensure systematic follow-up.



*Accurate Execution: Maintain impeccable detail orientation while logging notes and updating statuses. Your procedural discipline ensures our automated systems fire correctly and client data is preserved.



WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

*The "Hunter" Mentality: You are highly motivated, thrive on hitting targets, and get energized by closing deals.



*Extroverted & Outgoing Personality: You are naturally comfortable asserting yourself and taking control of a conversation. You build rapport instantly and can handle emotionally charged situations with professional confidence.



*Phone Presence: You are comfortable spending the majority of your shift on the phone. You maintain a high level of enthusiasm, empathy, and energy from your first dial to your last.



*Communication Mastery: You possess fluent English with very little or no detectable accent, ensuring crystal-clear communication and immediate trust-building with our clientele.



*Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience navigating the GoHighLevel CRM (or similar advanced sales platforms) and can quickly adapt to our proprietary technological tools.



*Remote Work Ready: You have a dedicated and distraction-free home workspace, supported by a reliable, high-speed internet connection.



WHAT WE OFFER

*Competitive Base + Uncapped Commission: Start with a $10/hr base rate, augmented by a lucrative commission structure. High performers have the clear opportunity to push $40k+/yr in total compensation through uncapped commissions and performance incentives.



*Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Work within a custom-built instance of GoHighLevel, supercharged by proprietary tools and automation developed in-house by our software engineering team.



*Warm, High-Intent Leads: 100% of the leads you engage with have actively requested our help and are expecting to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include a link to a voice recording saying: "Hi Ryan, my name is [your name] with All 50 Law. I'm following up on the form you submitted to us through
 seeking legal representation. Please call me back at your earliest convenience." Applications without this recording will not be considered.

title: Apparel, Garment & Textile Sourcing Specialist for a Lifestyle Brand
description:
Hi! I'm Ewald, founder of a German brand in the football and lifestyle

space. We make high quality apparel for amateur football clubs. Every

club has its own story, and its clothing should feel like it.



I'm looking for a TALENT with real sourcing experience who can help me

find the right manufacturers: in the Philippines, elsewhere in Asia or

in Europe.



HOW IT WORKS

Each club gets its own collection, designed by us. Members and fans

order within a fixed time window. After that, we produce everything in

one run and ship it to the club. We only produce what has already been

sold.



THE CHALLENGE

One club usually orders around 20 to 150 pieces per product. Most

factories ask for 300 or 500 pieces per design. We solve this in two

ways:

• Bundling: we combine the orders of several clubs into one production

  run of the same base product. Each club's design is added at the end

  through embroidery, print or patches. This way, orders of 200 to 500

  pieces can be realistic.

• Small runs: we are just as happy to go small, with partners who

  deliver premium quality even at low quantities.



THE PRODUCTS

Zip hoodies, hoodies, jerseys and shorts, as well as scarves, beanies

and socks. Lifestyle, not performance sportswear. Quality comes first:

good fabrics, clean finishing, pieces people love to wear.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Find and vet manufacturers and decorators (knitting, cut and sew,

  print, embroidery)

• Request quotes and samples, compare minimums, prices and lead times

• Negotiate low minimums for first orders

• Check samples for fabric, fit and finishing



MUST HAVE

• Hands on experience in apparel sourcing or production

• You know fabrics, weights (GSM), knitting and printing methods

• Factory contacts, or you know exactly how to find reliable ones

• Honest communication: you tell me early when something won't work

• Good English



BIG BONUS

• Experience with jerseys and sublimation printing

• Contacts in several countries

• Knowledge of shipping and import to Europe



HOW WE WORK

We start with paid gigs. If it's a great fit and the company grows,

there's a real path to a long term role. Talent matters more to me than

years of experience. I invest in people and want us to grow together.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Tell me what you have done so far in sourcing or production:

   which products, which countries, which kind of clients.

2. Which product categories and countries do you know best?

3. Your availability and rate.



I read every application carefully. Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: TikTok Video Editor (Short Form Content)
description:
This is a fully remote position and may require shifting schedules, weekend coverage, and overtime based on business needs.



Who We Are



At Neuro, we empower better minds with innovative, science-backed formulas. Our products are accessible, portable, shareable, and designed to work fast, wherever life takes you.



We're a premium functional wellness brand helping people optimize focus, clarity, energy, and cognitive performance through clean, effective gum and mints.



Neuro has been featured by The Joe Rogan Experience, Fast Company, The New Yorker, and The Daily Beast, and our founders appeared on Shark Tank Season 11.



About the Role



We're looking for a highly creative Short Form Video Editor who lives and breathes TikTok.

Your primary responsibility will be transforming long-form content including podcasts, interviews, speaking engagements, founder videos, and other brand content into engaging short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical video platforms.



This is not a traditional video editing role. We're looking for someone who understands what makes content perform: compelling hooks, storytelling, pacing, audience retention, captions, sound design, and internet culture.



You'll work closely with our Marketing team to build Neuro's founder brand by creating engaging content featuring Kent Yoshimura, Ryan Chen, and other Neuro creators.



We're less interested in cinematic editing and more interested in your ability to create TikTok content that people actually watch, share, and engage with. If you naturally think about hooks, retention, pacing, and storytelling, you'll thrive in this role.



What You'll Do

- Edit engaging short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical video platforms.

- Transform long-form content including podcasts, interviews, speaking engagements, and founder content into multiple short-form videos.

- Identify compelling moments from long-form videos without requiring detailed direction.

- Create strong hooks within the first 1- 3 seconds to maximize viewer retention.

- Add captions, motion graphics, animations, sound effects, zooms, transitions, B-roll, and other visual elements that enhance engagement.

- Follow current TikTok trends, editing styles, storytelling techniques, and platform best practices.

- Optimize videos for watch time, engagement, shares, and overall content performance.

- Repurpose a single long-form video into multiple unique short-form assets.

- Collaborate closely with the Marketing and Creative teams while contributing new content ideas.

- Organize project files and maintain an efficient editing workflow.

- Deliver high-quality content while managing multiple deadlines.

- Use AI-powered editing tools where appropriate to improve efficiency without compromising quality.



What We're Looking For (Required Qualifications)

- 2+ years of professional experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

- Strong portfolio showcasing high-performing short-form content.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software.

- Strong understanding of TikTok trends, internet culture, storytelling, pacing, and retention editing.

- Ability to identify engaging moments from long-form conversations and transform them into compelling short-form content.

- Experience creating captions, motion graphics, and engaging on-screen text.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to receive feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free remote workspace.

- Willingness to work shifting schedules and overtime when required.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

- Adobe After Effects

- Photoshop or Illustrator

- Motion graphics and animation

- AI-powered editing tools (CapCut AI, Adobe AI, Runway, Descript, Opus Clip, or similar)

- Editing content for founders, podcasts, creators, influencers, or consumer brands

- Experience using TikTok analytics or Creator Center to optimize content performance



What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role if you:

- Consistently transform long-form content into engaging short-form videos.

- Understand what keeps viewers watching from beginning to end.

- Create content that feels native to TikTok rather than traditional advertising.

- Deliver high-quality edits with minimal revisions.

- Balance creativity with speed while consistently meeting deadlines.

- Stay ahead of editing trends while maintaining Neuro's brand voice.

- Continuously bring fresh ideas that improve content performance and audience engagement.



Why You'll Love Working at Neuro

- Fully remote work environment.

- Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing functional wellness brands.

- Collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team.

- Work that directly impacts Neuro's social media growth and brand presence.

- A culture that values creativity, ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



How to Apply

- If you're interested in joining the Neuro team, please
 the following to 

- A PDF copy of your resume.

- A portfolio showcasing your best TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or other short-form editing work.

- A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom, Google Drive, or another shareable link) telling us a little about yourself, your editing experience, and why you're interested in joining Neuro.



We're evaluating your ability to identify compelling moments, tell a story, and create content that feels native to TikTok. Technical editing skills are important, but we're primarily looking for editors who understand what keeps people watching, sharing, and engaging with short-form content.
