title: Fundraising & Donor Relations Coordinator
description:
Your Mission

Grow and deepen the relationships that fund Rebels for Peace by finding new supporters, stewarding existing donors, strengthening fundraising communication, and helping turn one-time donors into long-term champions of the organization.

This role exists to help Rebels for Peace become consistently excellent at donor relationships, fundraising follow-up, grant management, and communicating the impact of our work.



About Rebels for Peace

Rebels for Peace is a Chicago-based nonprofit working with youth and communities impacted by gun violence.

Through social-emotional learning, leadership development, mentorship, and community engagement, we help young people build the skills, resilience, and relationships they need to choose peace and become leaders in their communities.

We are looking for a highly organized, relationship-oriented, and proactive Fundraising & Donor Relations Coordinator who can help us strengthen the way we find, engage, and retain the people and organizations that make our work possible.

This is a hands-on development role for someone who enjoys building relationships, writing, researching opportunities, creating strong communication, and making sure important follow-up happens.



What You’ll Do

Donor Relations & Stewardship

Build and maintain strong relationships with donors, supporters, sponsors, and prospective donors.

Make sure donors are consistently thanked, updated, engaged, and shown the impact of their support throughout the year.

Track donor relationships, communication, giving history, next steps, and opportunities in the CRM.

Help the Executive Director stay prepared for donor and funder meetings with relevant background, relationship history, and recommended next steps.



Donor Growth & Fundraising

Research and identify new individual donors, corporate supporters, foundations, sponsors, and other fundraising opportunities.

Help grow and manage the fundraising pipeline from initial prospect through cultivation and ongoing stewardship.

Support outreach, follow-up, sponsorship conversations, fundraising campaigns, and donor engagement.

Help turn one-time supporters into long-term relationships with Rebels for Peace.

Rebel Games Peer to peer campaign 

Help develop a strong year-round donor communication and stewardship strategy around Rebel Games, our peer-to-peer fundraising campaign.

Support participants, donors, teams, and sponsors before, during, and after the campaign.

Help ensure Rebel Games relationships continue beyond the campaign itself and become part of the broader Rebels for Peace community.



Grants Management

Research and identify relevant foundation, corporate, and government grant opportunities.

Maintain an organized grant pipeline and track upcoming opportunities, deadlines, applications, reports, and renewals.

Draft and coordinate grant applications, letters of inquiry, proposals, and funder communications.

Coordinate with program and finance staff to gather information needed for applications and reports.

Help ensure grant reports are accurate, compelling, and submitted on time.



Fundraising Communications

Help create consistent, high-quality communication with donors and supporters.

Draft donor updates, thank-you messages, campaign communication, proposals, sponsorship materials, newsletters, and follow-up.

Gather stories, program results, photos, and impact information that help donors understand the difference their support makes.

Help make sure Rebels for Peace communicates with supporters throughout the year—not only when we are asking for money.



What Success Looks Like

In this role:

Every significant donor and prospect has a clear next step.

Existing donors are consistently stewarded throughout the year.

The donor and prospect pipeline continues to grow.

New grant opportunities are proactively identified and pursued.

Grant applications and reports are organized, strong, and submitted on time.

Rebel Games becomes a year-round relationship-building opportunity.

Donor and funder information in the CRM is accurate and actively used.

The Executive Director is well prepared for important donor and funder conversations.

Fundraising communication is consistent, thoughtful, and high quality.

More supporters move from one-time engagement to long-term relationships with Rebels for Peace.



What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

Relationship-oriented and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

Strong at writing, communication, and follow-through.

Organized and able to manage multiple donor, grant, and fundraising priorities at once.

Proactive and comfortable identifying opportunities rather than waiting for them to appear.

Comfortable researching donors, funders, businesses, foundations, and fundraising opportunities.

Able to communicate professionally with donors, funders, executives, corporate partners, and community stakeholders.

Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets,
 platforms, and other digital tools.

Detail-oriented and able to manage deadlines and important information accurately.

Interested in youth development, violence prevention, social impact, philanthropy, or community-based work.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

Donor relations or donor stewardship

Fundraising

Grant research or grant writing

Development or nonprofit advancement

Sponsorships or corporate partnerships

CRM management

Fundraising campaigns or peer-to-peer fundraising

Donor or nonprofit communications

We are open to someone who is still growing in their development career but has demonstrated strong judgment, initiative, communication skills, and the ability to build relationships.



The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who sees fundraising as more than asking for money.

You believe strong fundraising starts with strong relationships. You enjoy learning about people, staying connected, communicating impact, finding new opportunities, and making sure supporters feel like they are genuinely part of the mission.

title: Executive Assistant to Founder/CEO
description:

This is not simply a data-entry or basic administrative VA role. I am looking for someone who can help me stay organised, protect my time, keep track of commitments, follow up on actions and gradually become a trusted source of operational support.

The right person will be comfortable taking responsibility for recurring tasks without needing constant instruction and will help create structure around a busy working schedule.

Key Responsibilities

- Managing and organising my calendar in line with agreed priorities and working patterns.

- Preparing my weekly schedule and helping protect dedicated time for CEO work, business development, study and meetings.

- Maintaining action lists and following up outstanding tasks with me and members of the team.

- Preparing agendas, meeting notes and clear action summaries.

- Supporting my weekly CEO review and helping track priorities through to completion.

- Organising documents, folders, templates and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Drafting and formatting
s, documents and basic reports.

- Scheduling pre-prepared content across social media platforms and ensuring the agreed content schedule is maintained.

- Researching potential leads, organisations, events and contacts aligned with agreed business-development priorities.

- Supporting initial outreach to potential leads and contacts using agreed messaging and approaches.

- Maintaining an organised pipeline of potential contacts, leads and opportunities and ensuring agreed follow-ups take place.

- Supporting simple financial administration and maintaining trackers such as cash-flow forecasts.

- Keeping track of deadlines, appointments, commitments and important follow-ups across multiple projects.

- Carrying out research and other executive-support tasks as required.

Who I'm Looking For

You should be extremely organised, reliable, proactive and comfortable working independently.

I need someone who notices when something has not been completed and follows it up rather than simply waiting to be told what to do next.

You should have excellent written English and communication skills and be confident using common digital tools such as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace. You should also be comfortable learning new systems, including calendars, CRM platforms, project-management tools and social-media scheduling platforms.

Previous experience supporting a Founder, CEO, Director, Executive or busy entrepreneur would be particularly valuable.

You should be someone who:

- Takes ownership of tasks.

- Communicates clearly when something is unclear or delayed.

- Pays close attention to detail.

- Can manage several priorities without losing track of actions.

- Is comfortable following systems and SOPs.

- Can also use initiative when a system does not yet exist.

- Understands confidentiality and discretion.

- Is dependable and consistent.



Working Arrangement

The role will initially be approximately 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

The preferred working period is:

9:00am–12:00pm UK time, Monday–Friday.

Applicants should ensure these hours work within their local timezone before applying.

There is potential for the responsibilities and number of hours to grow significantly for the right person as trust develops and more responsibilities are delegated.

When Applying

Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Details of your previous experience supporting founders, CEOs, executives or business owners.

3. An example of a situation where you noticed something needed to be done and proactively solved the problem without waiting to be asked.

title: UGC Creator Recruiter & Talent Casting Specialist - $800-$1,000/mo + Performance

🎬 UGC Creator Recruiter & Talent Casting Specialist (Full-Time Remote)



Company: Next Take Media

Hours: 40 hours/week (Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM US Eastern Time required overlap, remaining 4 hours flexible)

Location: 100% Remote (Work from home anywhere in the Philippines)



---



Are You a Proactive Talent Sourcer Who Understands Video Content?



At Next Take Media, we produce high-performing direct-response video ads for fast-growing 7- and 8-figure service businesses, marketing agencies, and high-ticket brands. We script, cast, film, and edit 10 to 20 launch-ready video ads delivered in 7 business days.



We are NOT looking for generic TikTok lip-syncers or beauty unboxing influencers. 



We are building a world-class bench of on-camera commercial presenters and direct-response creators: business executives, seasoned financial advisors, authentic blue-collar tradesmen, and energetic growth operators.



We are looking for a sharp, organized, and hungry UGC Creator Recruiter & Casting Specialist to own our talent pipeline. You will be responsible for hunting down top creators, running cold outreach, reviewing audition tapes, and managing our active talent database.



If you love social media research, have an eye for great camera presence, and take pride in running a clean CRM, this is your dream role.



---



What You Will Do Every Day:



1. Active Talent Hunting (30 to 50 Outreach Daily):

   - Use our step-by-step search SOPs to find creators on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Backstage.

   - Reverse-engineer winning ads in the Meta Ad Library using reverse-image search tools (Google Lens / PimEyes) to find proven commercial presenters.

   - Send personalized cold DMs, InMails, and
s to prospective talent every single day.



2. Audition Triage & Script Distribution:

   - Respond to interested creators within 2 hours during your shift.

   - Send our standardized 30-second audition test script and track submission deadlines.



3. Audition Vetting & Scoring:

   - Review incoming audition takes using our 100-Point Direct-Response Rubric.

   - Grade video submissions on hook energy, direct eye contact, clear vocal cadence, audio clarity (zero background hiss/echo), and 4K/1080p camera quality.



4. Creator Onboarding & CRM Hygiene:

   - Send our standard commercial contract and usage agreements to approved creators.

   - Log all headshots, contact information, portfolio reels, audio/video specs, and signed agreements into our central Airtable Creator CRM.



5. Daily Reporting:

   - Post your End-of-Day (EOD) metrics in Slack so the team has full visibility into the creator pipeline.



---



What Makes You the Ideal Candidate:



- Proven Experience: At least 1-2 years of experience recruiting UGC creators, influencers, or commercial talent for an e-commerce brand, marketing agency, or media company.

- Direct-Response Awareness: You understand that a good ad actor isn't just someone who looks pretty. You understand vocal energy, hook retention, and commercial conviction.

- Scrappy Online Detective: You know how to track down someone's
 or social media handle from a short video clip or a screenshot.

- Flawless English Communication: Your written English is 100% fluent, professional, and conversational.

- Tech & Tool Savvy: Fluent with Airtable, Notion, Slack, Google Drive, Loom, and Google Sheets.

- Reliable Home Setup:

  - Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) with a backup connection.

  - Quiet dedicated home workspace with a modern laptop or desktop computer.

  - Power backup (UPS / power station) in case of local power outages.



---



Compensation & Growth:



- Base Salary: $800 to $1,000 USD / month (45,000 to 56,000 PHP) based on experience.

- Performance Bonuses: $25 USD cash bonus for every vetted creator who passes our audition rubric, signs their contract, and joins our active roster (realistic potential for an extra $200 to $400/month).

- 13th Month Pay: Provided at the end of every calendar year.

- Paid Time Off (PTO): Paid vacation and sick leave after 6 months.

- Long-Term Career Growth: High-performing recruiters have a direct pathway to become our full-time Creative Operations Manager or Head of Casting.



---



How to Apply (Follow These Instructions Carefully):



We receive hundreds of applications for our openings. To prove that you read job posts carefully and pay attention to detail, you must follow these exact 4 steps:



1. Subject Line: Change your application subject line to:  

   [NEXT TAKE RECRUITER] - Your Full Name - Years of UGC Experience  

   (Example: [NEXT TAKE RECRUITER] - Maria Santos - 2 Years)



2. 60-Second Loom Video (Mandatory):  

   Record a quick 60-second video of yourself on Loom. In the video, please tell us:

   - Your name and where you are based in the Philippines.

   - A brief summary of your experience recruiting UGC creators or influencers.

   - What is the number one thing you look for when judging if a creator is good on camera?  

   (Please make sure your Loom link is set to "Public" so we can watch it).



3. Short Written Questions (Answer in your message body):

   - What tools or databases have you previously used to find creators?

   - Link 1 example of a video ad or creator you think has incredible hook energy and camera delivery.

   - Provide a screenshot of your current internet speed test from speedtest.net.



4. Your Resume / Portfolio: Attach a link to your resume or portfolio.



Note: Any application that does not include the exact subject line or the 60-second Loom video link will be automatically archived without review. (you can use

We look forward to meeting our next superstar recruiter!

title: Asset & Lease Manager
description:
Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.



Work Setup

Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift

Must have a computer with a webcam

Reliable high-speed internet



What You'll Do

Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.

Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.

Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.

Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.

Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.

Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.

Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.

Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.

Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.

Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.

Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.

Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.

Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.

Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.

Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.

Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).

Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.



What We're Looking For

4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios

Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements

Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms

Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements

Advanced Excel

Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers

Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences

Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law

Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system

Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

title: Lead Inquiry specialist
description:
# Do You Have Excellent English-Speaking Skills?



## Are You a Sales-Minded People Person Who Thrives on the Phone?



**Our Agency is looking for a Lead Inquiry Specialist to manage a high volume of incoming calls, connect with prospective clients and families, and turn inquiries into opportunities.**



This is not a passive call-answering position. We’re looking for someone who is confident, personable, sales-minded, and comfortable taking ownership of every inquiry that comes their way.



You’ll often be the **first voice a potential client or family hears**, so your ability to build rapport quickly, ask the right questions, communicate value, and confidently move the conversation toward the next step is critical.



If you’re a self-starter who loves talking to people, knows how to sell without sounding scripted, and can keep up in a fast-moving environment, we want to hear from you.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



As our **Lead Inquiry Specialist**, you’ll be responsible for answering a **very high volume of incoming calls and inquiries** from prospective clients, families, referral sources, and others interested in Home Care services.



Your goal isn’t simply to answer the phone — it’s to create an exceptional first impression, understand what the caller needs, communicate how we can help, and move qualified leads forward.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Answering a high volume of incoming calls promptly, professionally, and confidently

• Speaking with prospective clients and family members about their home care needs

• Using a consultative sales approach to build rapport, uncover needs, overcome objections, and move inquiries toward the next step

• Accurately entering, updating, and managing lead information in **Salesforce**

• Working within **WellSky** to review client information and support the inquiry and intake process

• Following up consistently with leads who are not ready to move forward immediately

• Maintaining detailed and accurate documentation of every interaction

• Prioritizing leads and recognizing which inquiries require immediate attention

• Communicating effectively with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from inquiry to consultation and start of care

• Taking ownership of leads rather than waiting to be told what needs to happen next

• Managing multiple conversations, systems, and priorities without sacrificing accuracy or customer service



## What You Bring to the Role



• **Excellent English-speaking and communication skills are required**

• **Previous Salesforce experience is required**

• **Previous WellSky experience is required**

• Previous **sales experience is required**, preferably in phone sales, inside sales, healthcare, home care, senior care, or another service-based industry

• You are extremely comfortable spending the majority of your day on the phone

• You can confidently handle a **high volume of incoming calls** while making each caller feel heard and valued

• You are a self-starter who takes initiative and doesn’t need constant direction

• You understand how to build rapport and guide a conversation toward a decision

• You are comfortable asking questions, addressing concerns, and following up until there is a clear outcome

• You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to document information accurately while speaking with callers

• You can move quickly between Salesforce,
, and other systems

• You remain professional and composed when callers are emotional, stressed, or uncertain

• You understand that **speed, follow-up, and consistency matter in sales**

• You are dependable and take ownership of your responsibilities



## What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who sees an incoming inquiry as more than another phone call.



Every call represents a person or family looking for help — and potentially a new client for our organization. The right person understands how to balance **compassion with sales**, creating a genuine connection while confidently moving the conversation forward.



You should be competitive enough to want to convert leads, compassionate enough to understand the families calling us, and organized enough to make sure **no opportunity falls through the cracks.**



### To Be Considered



Please upload:



• Your current resume

• A brief introduction video telling us about your experience with **sales, Salesforce, and high-volume phone calls**

title: Executive Assistant - Real Estate
description:
About Us

• This is not a general VA role. This role requires hands-on U.S. real estate experience and a strong understanding of the contract-to-close process.

, Microsoft 365, or similar systems.



Qualifications

• Strong knowledge of the U.S. real estate transaction process.

• Experience with MLS platforms, Dotloop or a similar transaction platform,

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

• Friendly, proactive, and resourceful with a client-first attitude.

• Ability to work independently and manage deadlines in a remote environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet, webcam, headset/microphone, and a quiet professional workspace.



Benefits

We are looking for a strategic, high-caliber Marketing Manager / Head of Marketing with an exceptional marketing brain and a proven ability to scale revenue.
